episodes.overview: Becky fights back when she finds herself targeted, Carl implicates Debbie in a financial oversight, and Cassie takes Tyrone to his physio appointment when Fiz is called away.

episodes.overview: Debbie takes centre stage to deliver a speech at a business event, Theo forces Todd to hide away in the flat, Dev questions Asha's future plans, and Roy catches Shona rifling through his mail.

episodes.overview: Becky hastens to Costello's bedside to cover her tracks, Will overhears Daniel asking Megan on a date, Theo sends Todd out for a run, and Dee-Dee refuses to commit to spending Christmas with Ollie.

episodes.overview: Todd stands up for himself against Theo, Becky and Kit race to be the first to gain access to Costello's phone, Daniel and Megan celebrate her job offer, and Dee-Dee shares some big news with Alya.

episodes.name: Monday, 8th December 2025
episodes.overview: As Maggie celebrates a milestone birthday, a glimpse at her earlier life reveals a complicated family history and indicates that Eva would be well advised not to underestimate her.

episodes.name: Wednesday, 10th December 2025
episodes.overview: The Metcalfes prepare to welcome Joanie's friends to Number Four, Kit voices his suspicions of Becky and Costello, and George shares his concern for Todd with Christina.

episodes.name: Friday, 12th December 2025
episodes.overview: Kit begins to connect the dots in his investigation, Debbie angers Kevin by inviting Carl and Abi to her wedding, and George and Christina are concerned by a report from Gary.

episodes.name: Monday, 15th December 2025
episodes.overview: The police descend on the street following a report of a domestic incident as the latest developments in Todd and Theo's increasingly disturbing relationship are caught on camera.

episodes.name: Tuesday, 16th December 2025
episodes.overview: George quizzes Todd and Theo about their row, Brody gets in the way of Will and Megan, Dee-Dee drops a bombshell as the Baileys toast her new job, and Cassie confronts Tracy.

episodes.name: Friday, 19th December 2025
episodes.overview: Will celebrates his 16th birthday in a hotel room with Megan, Sally clashes with Joanie over a schedule conflict, and Dee-Dee is saddened when James fails to turn up to her meal.

episodes.overview: Debbie is a no-show at her hen party, Becky grows alarmed at news of Costello's condition improving, Eva confides in Adam her guilt for deceiving Ben, and Asha attends a meeting at the hospital with her supervisor.

episodes.name: Wednesday, 24th December 2025
episodes.overview: Becky invites Lisa to revive their marriage, Maggie uncovers Eva and Adam's secret, Theo's Christmas plans surprise Todd, and James threatens to reveal Carl's betrayal to Abi.

episodes.overview: Secret Santa Maggie ensures the Driscolls do not have themselves a merry little Christmas. Lisa receives a troubling update from Roy, Carl tempts James to a festive fling, and Theo and Todd struggle to keep up their charade.

episodes.name: Friday, 26th December 2025
episodes.overview: As the residents reel from the events of Christmas Day, Evelyn finds someone unconscious in the ginnel after being attacked, and Theo's treat presents Todd with an awkward dilemma.

episodes.name: Monday, 29th December 2025
episodes.overview: George and Glenda celebrate their birthdays, Sarah and Kit are puzzled by Carla's silence, Maggie tries to win Ben around, and Theo leaves Todd out in the cold.

episodes.name: Tuesday, 30th December 2025

episodes.name: Wednesday, 31st December 2025

shows.name: The View
shows.overview: ABC Daytime's morning chatfest, currently featuring Whoopi Goldberg, Joy Behar, Sunny Hostin, Sara Haines, Alyssa Farah Griffin, and Ana Navarro discussing the most exciting events of the day. Hot topics in the news, the best experts in their field, celebrity interviews and general entertainment are all part of The View.

shows.name: The Graham Norton Show
shows.overview: Each week celebrity guests join Irish comedian Graham Norton to discuss what's being going on around the world that week. The guests poke fun and share their opinions on the main news stories. Graham is often joined by a band or artist to play the show out.

shows.name: Chronicles of the Sun
shows.overview: Claire is surprised when she gets arrested for the murder of her childhood friend after she returns to Montpellier.

shows.name: Avatar: Seven Havens
shows.overview: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

episodes.name: On the Horizon
episodes.overview: During a festival celebrating the demise of the Avatar, one orphan girl struggles to stay hidden until she crosses paths with a dutiful airbender.

episodes.name: Into the Storm
episodes.overview: When a massive storm hits Ellora, Team Avatar unites to save their home and are confronted by a strange entity.

episodes.name: The Order
episodes.overview: Being the Avatar is a lot of responsibility! Pavi is overwhelmed and misses her friends. Jae stumbles upon a secret organization and must make a life-altering decision.

episodes.name: The Faceless
episodes.overview: Team Avatar sets out to find a missing bender, leading them into a dangerous confrontation with a ruthless gang of bandits.

episodes.name: The One Left Behind
episodes.overview: While Jae and Karthik investigate brewing rumors that actively endanger the girls, Pavi and Nisha sneak into Karthik's office to uncover hidden answers about their parents.

episodes.name: Night of the Afflicted
episodes.overview: Karthik, Nisha, and Pavi must work together to quell a mass panic among the Afflicted inside the hospital. Meanwhile, Jae is forced to deal with a rising wave of unrest brewing within the Bending Brigade.

shows.name: Ici tout commence
shows.overview: This television drama series is centered around the prestigious culinary school of renowned chef Auguste Armand. The show follows the lives of students and staff as they navigate the challenges and pressures of the culinary world—delving into their personal and professional lives, revealing secrets, rivalries, and complex relationships.

shows.name: Jeopardy!
shows.overview: America's favorite quiz show where contestants are presented with general knowledge clues in the form of answers, and must phrase their responses in question form.

shows.name: LIVE with Kelly and Mark
shows.overview: A morning talk show with A-list celebrity guests, top-notch performances and one-of-a-kind segments that are unrivaled on daytime television, plus spontaneous, hilarious and unpredictable talk.

episodes.name: Lizzo, Kal Penn, and Tift Merritt
episodes.overview: LIZZO stops by the studio to talk about her book. Plus, KAL PENN is here to chat about “Trust Me, I’m a Doctor,” and TIFT MERRITT performs.

episodes.name: Gal Gadot
episodes.overview: GAL GADOT drops by for a chat about “The Runner,” and JIM KWIK shares a “positivity puzzle.”

shows.name: Quotidien
shows.overview: Quotidien (nicknamed "The French Show with the Good Lighting" abroad) is a French daily infotainment television program broadcast in the early evening on TMC since September 12, 2016. The show is hosted by Yann Barthès and produced by Bangumi. It consists of segments and reports produced by the team of commentators and journalists surrounding Yann Barthès and features daily guests including newsmakers, intellectuals, politicians, and French and international celebrities.

shows.name: El Señor de los Cielos
shows.overview: Set in the 1990s, these are the life and times of Amado Carrillo Fuentes, a man who became the head of the Juárez cartel. Nicknamed “El Señor de los Cielos” (Lord of the Skies) because of the large fleet of airplanes he used to transport drugs, he was also known for washing more than $200 million through Colombia to finance his huge fleet. He is described as the most powerful drug trafficker of his time.

shows.overview:
20/20 is an American television newsmagazine that has been broadcast on ABC since June 6, 1978. Created by ABC News executive Roone Arledge, the show was designed similarly to CBS's 60 Minutes but focuses more on human interest stories than international and political subjects. The program's name derives from the "20/20" measurement of visual acuity.

The hour-long program has been a staple on Friday evenings for much of the time since it moved to that timeslot from Thursdays in September 1987, though special editions of the program occasionally air on other nights.

episodes.name: The Salem Strangler
episodes.overview: After a young college student is found strangled on the side of the road, the case goes cold until an eerily similar attack breathes new life into the investigation and helps enforcement catch a killer.

episodes.name: Home Alone
episodes.overview: Allison Feldman, 31, was working in medical sales when she was found dead in her Scottsdale, Arizona, home in 2015. The crime shocked the community and left detectives with one major question: who could have committed such a violent attack without leaving an obvious connection to the victim?

episodes.name: Born to Kill
episodes.overview: Catherine "Cati" Ann Blavatsky, 22, is found dead inside a concrete box in the basement of an abandoned farmhouse. Her estranged husband goes on the run with a 17-year-old, leading authorities on a cross-country chase.

episodes.name: The Suitcase Murders
episodes.overview: In June 2014, a highway worker cutting grass discovers two large suitcases with foul odors beside a rural road in Wisconsin. Inside, investigators find the bodies of Jenny Gamez and Laura Simonson, leaving a community shocked and searching for answers.

episodes.overview: Who would want to kill Kristil Krug, a mom of three kids? Follow the clues in a race against time to catch a deadly stalker.

What began as a local tragedy has become a national conversation about truth, power, and accountability as Cross's claim of a wrong conviction gains momentum.

episodes.overview: Damián reconsiders Tasio's proposal about Floral. Doña Clara makes an unexpected offer to Paula. Mabel proposes changes in the cafeteria that Salva does not like.

episodes.name: Episode 620
episodes.overview: Fina makes a decision about Bianca's proposal. Marisol confesses to Pablo about the suicide attempt. Miguel clarifies his situation with Claudia. Valentina confesses her feelings to Andrés.

episodes.name: Episode 621
episodes.overview: Andrés shares good news with the family. Paula makes a decision about Doña Clara's trip. Damián asks Fina to put him in touch with Bianca.

episodes.name: Episode 622
episodes.overview: Gabriel proposes a special plan to Beatriz. A confession from Julia unsettles Begoña. Gabriel takes revenge on Andrés. Fina meets Doña Clara. Claudia has a fever.

episodes.name: Episode 623
episodes.overview: Gabriel makes an excuse at work so he doesn't attend Julia's performance. Manuela encourages Eduardo to go see Roque. Beatriz gets ready for her date with Gabriel.

episodes.name: Episode 624
episodes.overview: Miguel diagnoses Claudia. Bianca continues gaining ground with Fina. The tribute to Brossard takes place. Marta is jealous of Digna and Bianca's relationship.

episodes.name: Episode 625
episodes.overview: Mabel gets annoyed with Salva because of his behavior during dinner. Marta makes a proposal to Fina about Pelayo's money.

episodes.name: Episode 626
episodes.overview: Salva and Mabel open up. Gabriel sets conditions on a request from Begoña. Doña Clara makes an unexpected proposal to Marta. Miguel and Claudia clarify their situation.

episodes.name: Episode 627
episodes.overview: Tasio continues to have nightmares. Marta discovers that Valentina has slept with Andrés. Pablo receives an unexpected call. Miguel discharges Claudia.

episodes.name: Episode 628
episodes.overview: Pablo receives an unexpected warning. Clara pressures Marta about the foundation issue. Tasio notices coldness between Mabel and Salva. Eduardo receives an unexpected call.

episodes.name: Episode 629
episodes.overview: Digna comes up with an idea to regain the brand's prestige. Pablo receives bad news. Mabel makes a mistake in the cafeteria.

episodes.name: Episode 630
episodes.overview: Pablo's hernia is getting worse. Doña Clara makes an unexpected request to Fina. Valentina and Andrés attend the tea.

episodes.name: Episode 631
episodes.overview: Beatriz tries to regain Begoña's trust. Claudia tries to build bridges with Paula. Marta proposes something unexpected to Doña Clara.

episodes.name: Episode 632
episodes.overview: Miguel is determined to be the perfect boyfriend, will he achieve it? Roque discovers a lie from Eduardo. Julia asks Begoña a compromising question.

episodes.name: Episode 633
episodes.overview: Pablo remains hospitalized. Beatriz plants a doubt about Begoña in Gabriel. Eduardo still has no news from Roque. Marta confronts Bianca.

episodes.name: Episode 634
episodes.overview: Don Agustín offers comfort to the Salazar family. Beatriz encourages Begoña to fight for Andrés. Gabriel announces unexpected news. Fina and Marta argue.

episodes.name: Episode 635
episodes.overview: Marta decides to take action in the stores regarding Gabriel's movement. Claudia and Tasio have an argument about Paula. Begoña writes a love letter to Andrés.

episodes.name: Episode 636
episodes.overview: Miguel tries to revive Pablo. Beatriz discovers that the girls at the store have hidden the Brossard products. Mabel still does not lean on Salva. Beatriz manipulates Andrés.

episodes.name: Episode 637
episodes.overview: Pablo makes a decision about his surgery. Valentina tries to mediate between Paula and Claudia. Don Agustín offers his help to Nieves. Gabriel scolds the girls in the store.

episodes.name: Episode 638
episodes.overview: Miguel encourages Pablo before the operation. Marta tells the girls to submit to Gabriel. Mabel makes a decision about her relationship with Salva.

episodes.name: Episode 639
episodes.overview: Pablo is taken to the operating room. Valentina sees a knowing gesture from Andrés to Begoña. Damián makes a decision about Eduardo's stay in the house.

episodes.name: Episode 640
episodes.overview: Pablo wakes up from the surgery. Gabriel confronts Begoña about the photos with Andrés. Bianca makes a move again with Fina. Miguel makes a request to Claudia.

episodes.name: Episode 641
episodes.overview: Julia defends Begoña in front of Gabriel. Salva supports Mabel. The dealer is not satisfied with Fina's work. Eduardo reminisces about his years of traveling.

episodes.name: Episode 642
episodes.overview: Damián demands that Tasio bring Carmen back. Digna finds out about Begoña's problems. Roque makes an unexpected confession to Eduardo.

episodes.name: Episode 643
episodes.overview: Begoña makes a request to Digna. Marta discovers that Bianca spent the night at Fina's house. Pablo is discharged. Salva makes an unexpected proposal to Mabel.

episodes.name: Episode 644
episodes.overview: Fina suffers a nervous breakdown. Andrés confronts Gabriel. A last-minute absence disappoints Pablo. Eduardo makes a decision about whether or not to go with Roque.

episodes.name: Episode 645
episodes.overview: Andrés and Valentina inform the family that they are getting married. Fina goes to the clinic. Begoña finds out about Andrés and Valentina's wedding. Miguel scolds Tasio.

episodes.name: Episode 646
episodes.overview: Gabriel tells Begoña about his victory over the De la Reina family. Fina moves into the big house. Tasio reproaches Claudia for telling Miguel about her past.

episodes.name: Episode 647
episodes.overview: Julia makes an uncomfortable request to Begoña. Gabriel reprimands Paula. Pablo offers Valentina the position of secretary.

episodes.name: Episode 648
episodes.overview: Tasio makes a decision about his plan to sabotage Gabriel. Andrés argues with Damián. Marta prevents Bianca from visiting Fina.

episodes.name: Episode 649
episodes.overview: Digna notices tension between Damián and Andrés. Valentina communicates her decision about the job offer. Tasio attacks Gabriel.

episodes.name: Episode 650
episodes.overview: Miguel issues an injuries report to Gabriel. Pablo warns Damián about Tasio's behavior. Beatriz tries to poison Begoña.

episodes.name: Episode 651
episodes.overview: Pablo proposes a family plan to his children. Andrés and Marta try to mediate with Tasio. Miguel diagnoses Beatriz.

episodes.name: Episode 652
episodes.overview: Digna has an idea to be able to save Gervasio's legacy. Valentina is overwhelmed by the engagement gift for Andrés.

episodes.name: Episode 653
episodes.overview: Begoña realizes Beatriz's pregnancy. Gabriel makes Valentina uncomfortable about the real reason for her promotion. Bianca makes an unexpected proposal to Fina.

episodes.name: Episode 654
episodes.overview: Paula has an awkward moment in the store because of a customer. Begoña is not prepared to attend Andrés's proposal. Valentina asks Damián and Marta for explanations about her promotion.

episodes.name: Episode 655
episodes.overview: Marta and Andrés stand up to Gabriel. Paula vents to Salva. Dorotea tries to calm Valentina. Miguel invites Claudia to his house.

episodes.name: Episode 656
episodes.overview: Gabriel has a modernization proposal for the factory. Dorotea says goodbye to Valentina. Marta tries to reconcile with Fina. Miguel makes a move on Claudia.

episodes.name: Episode 657
episodes.overview: Digna receives an unexpected gift from Luis. Andrés asks Valentina not to resign. Gabriel continues urging Beatriz to go to Madrid.

episodes.name: Episode 658
episodes.overview: Marta feels betrayed by Fina. The Salazars make an unexpected offer to Josema. Pablo confronts Gabriel over firing Marta and Andrés.

episodes.name: Episode 659
episodes.overview: Mabel thinks that Salva has a new fling. Julia reproaches Gabriel for firing her aunt and uncle. Miguel makes an unexpected request to Claudia.

episodes.name: Episode 660
episodes.overview: Manuela is nervous about the meal with the Salazars. Beatriz surprises Begoña by interviewing her possible replacement. Claudia makes Fina reflect on Marta.

episodes.name: Episode 661
episodes.overview: Nieves suggests to Mabel that she ask Josema for help with a task. Gabriel finds out that Miranda met with the De la Reina family. Marta gets excited after a decision from Fina.

episodes.name: Episode 662
episodes.overview: Manuela fears she may have let herself go too much with the Salazars. Miranda informs the De la Reina family of the outcome of her negotiation with Gabriel.

episodes.name: Episode 663
episodes.overview: Gabriel threatens Begoña for her betrayal. Marta believes that Fina and Bianca are together. Don Agustín asks Claudia for help.

episodes.name: Episode 664
episodes.overview: Gabriel scolds Pablo for Hugo's arrival. Valentina confronts Begoña about the issue with Andrés. Manuela tries to apologize to the Salazars.

episodes.name: Episode 665
episodes.overview: Agustín admonishes Miguel for a diagnosis of a patient. Claudia proposes a girls' plan. Salva writes a letter to his father. Damián and Andrés meet with Hugo.

episodes.name: Episode 666
episodes.overview: Gabriel spends his last cartridge with Hugo Brossard. Claudia believes there is something between Manuela and Eduardo. Hugo confronts Tasio.

episodes.name: Episode 667
episodes.overview: Hugo asks Gabriel for explanations after his meeting with Tasio. Mabel thinks she knows who Salva is seeing. Bianca makes a request to Marta. Damián scolds Tasio.

episodes.name: Episode 668
episodes.overview: Josema confesses to Mabel the reason for his initial reluctance to help her with her project. Andrés warns Begoña about Beatriz.

episodes.name: Episode 669
episodes.overview: Begoña lies to Gabriel about the reason for her argument with Beatriz. Mabel and Claudia test Salva and Paula about their relationship. Begoña no longer trusts Beatriz.

episodes.name: Episode 670
episodes.overview: Begoña confesses to Gabriel the reason for her argument with Beatriz. Tasio asks Paula to keep up appearances with Salva.

episodes.name: Episode 671
episodes.overview: Begoña wants to fire Beatriz. Mabel meets with the boy from the bus. Andrés and Valentina make the wedding guest list. Fina clarifies her situation with Bianca to Marta.

episodes.name: Episode 672
episodes.overview: Andrés communicates the wedding date to Marta and Julia. Salva does not understand his father's attitude. Tasio convinces Damián that he will be able to carry out La Industrial's assignment.

episodes.name: Episode 673
episodes.overview: Fina considers leaving the factory so that Marta does not suffer. Paula makes an unexpected request to Tasio. Julia receives bad news and leaves home.

episodes.name: Episode 674
episodes.overview: Digna and Damián make a proposal to Begoña. Eduardo gets angry with Manuela. Bianca makes an unexpected proposal to Fina. Damián receives a call that leaves him worried.

episodes.name: Episode 270
episodes.overview: Digna doesn't know how to deal with what happened, and she's unable to confront her family. Marta and Pelayo reconsider their cohabitation agreement.

episodes.name: Episode 271
episodes.overview: Fina comforts Marta. Manuela is surprised to see so much affection between the two. Andrés tries to protect Begoña from the Civil Guard.

episodes.name: Episode 272
episodes.overview: Damián, with Manuela's support, tries to cope with his son's wake. Digna, hiding her guilt, decides to attend Jesús's wake.

episodes.name: Episode 273
episodes.overview: Fermín makes a kind gesture toward Irene: they begin to see each other differently. Marta shares with Fina that she feels guilty about her brother's suicide.

episodes.name: Episode 274
episodes.overview: María, devastated by the loss of her son, offers to help with the childcare center. Carmen makes a business proposal to Marta.

episodes.name: Episode 275
episodes.overview: In front of workers upset by Górriz's departure, Joaquín announces his resignation. Gema reveals to Begoña that María has disappeared after kidnapping a baby from the nursery.

episodes.name: Episode 276
episodes.overview: After what happened with the baby, and the threat of a lawsuit looming, Andrés seeks to protect María. After Jesús's death, Begoña fears for her continued presence in the De la Reina house.

episodes.name: Episode 277
episodes.overview: Andrés and Begoña spend the night together. Manuela visits María at the nursing home.

episodes.name: Episode 278
episodes.overview: Julia intercedes for Manuela so that she won't be fired. Pelayo reveals to Marta the reason why he couldn't return to Darío.

episodes.name: Episode 279
episodes.overview: Damián scolds Andrés and Begoña for what he discovered the night before. Raúl, aspiring to be the new driver, arrives and, with his self-confidence, seems to have caught Claudia's attention.

episodes.name: Episode 280
episodes.overview: Marta alerts Damián to Don Pedro and Tasio's movements. Darío opens up to Fina, and they begin to come closer.

episodes.name: Episode 281
episodes.overview: Damián confesses his jealousy of Don Pedro to Digna. Gema and Joaquín are trying to have children, and her tiredness gives them hope. Is she already pregnant?

episodes.name: Episode 282
episodes.overview: Damián confesses his jealousy of Don Pedro to Digna. Andrés asks Raúl to go to the nursing home to look for María.

episodes.name: Episode 283
episodes.overview: As a result of Jesús' will, Begoña fears losing Julia, but Andrés isn't going to sit idly by...

episodes.name: Episode 284
episodes.overview: Andrés tries to support Begoña, who suffers inconsolably after seeing that she has lost Julia: Andrés and María will be her guardians.

episodes.name: Episode 285
episodes.overview: María lets the girls in the store know that she is Julia's legal guardian and therefore controls her actions.

episodes.name: Episode 286
episodes.overview: After being discovered, Luz confronts Herrera and reproaches him for not being able to continue practicing due to his condition as an addict.

episodes.name: Episode 287
episodes.overview: María tries to assert herself over Andrés when he scolds her for her confrontation with Begoña. Marta talks with Pelayo about the compatibility of ambition in work and love.

episodes.name: Episode 288
episodes.overview: Herrera listens to Damián and Begoña and takes a big step toward overcoming his addiction. Irene discovers Digna and Don Pedro after they spent the night together.

episodes.name: Episode 289
episodes.overview: The family is distressed by Luis's surgery. Don Agustín is opposed to Carmen's door-to-door sales plan.

episodes.name: Episode 290
episodes.overview: Luz, who saw Gema very upset during Luis's operation, inquires about what is happening to her.

episodes.name: Episode 291
episodes.overview: Damián makes a move in his business war against Don Pedro: he contacts an old acquaintance of the businessman.

episodes.name: Episode 292
episodes.overview: Herrera, aware of his problem, is determined to cleanse himself. Digna makes a decision regarding Don Pedro's marriage proposal.

episodes.name: Episode 293
episodes.overview: Damián asks the private detective to investigate Don Pedro. Carmen and Tasio celebrate the successful meeting together.

episodes.name: Episode 294
episodes.overview: Begoña wants to make it clear that María isn't a good influence on Julia. Marta informs Fina about what happened during the meeting.

episodes.name: Episode 295
episodes.overview: Luz, worried, tells Begoña that Damián knows her secret. Digna is pleased to see Don Pedro maintain a friendly attitude toward Andrés.

episodes.name: Episode 296
episodes.overview: After being discharged, Luis returns home! The perfumer wants to work, but Luz and Digna won't let him...

episodes.name: Episode 297
episodes.overview: Gema and Joaquín are very excited about the adoption and can't help but make plans for their future child.

episodes.name: Episode 298
episodes.overview: Gema tells Joaquín her suspicions about Don Agustín: they must think of alternative ways to adopt.

episodes.name: Episode 299
episodes.overview: Luz enjoys practicing medicine again at the dispensary. Begoña asks to leave a little early to make a plan with Julia.

episodes.name: Episode 300
episodes.overview: Despite Andrés's efforts to prevent it, Begoña seems determined to leave the De la Reina house.

episodes.name: Episode 301
episodes.overview: After receiving the tip-off from Ángel Ruiz, Damián warns Andrés of Don Pedro's possible influence in the rejection of his marriage annulment.

episodes.name: Episode 302
episodes.overview: Tensions reach their peak between María and the De la Reina family when her collaboration with Don Pedro is revealed.

episodes.name: Episode 303
episodes.overview: Fina can't bear the pressure of having Ángel Ruiz around any longer and suffers a seizure. While treating her, Begoña discovers an important secret about Fina.

episodes.name: Episode 304
episodes.overview: Andrés reveals to Begoña the decision he's made regarding Julia's guardianship. Manuela updates Claudia on the problems she had with Gaspar.

episodes.name: Episode 305
episodes.overview: Ángel Ruiz tells Damián a secret about Irene's past. María continues her game of manipulation with Julia.

episodes.name: Episode 306
episodes.overview: Andrés has made a final decision regarding Julia's guardianship. Teo isn't used to so much attention and feels overwhelmed.

episodes.name: Episode 307
episodes.overview: Don Pedro learns important news about Julia's guardianship. Joaquín, plagued by doubts about Teo's adoption, makes a decision regarding his adoption process.

episodes.name: Episode 308
episodes.overview: Joaquín learns that the money he sent to the nuns never arrived. Luz vents to Begoña because she's still upset about the argument she had with Luis.

episodes.name: Episode 309
episodes.overview: It's been Julia's play at school, and everyone is beaming with pride at her performance as Cinderella... but María is trying to spoil the party for them.

episodes.name: Episode 310
episodes.overview: Teo continues to display a difficult attitude, which leaves Gema feeling bitter. Manuela warns Claudia about Raúl: he's a jerk.

episodes.name: Episode 311
episodes.overview: Digna asks Don Pedro to withdraw his offer for Julia's shares. Doña Clara has broken her arm and will spend a few days recovering at the De la Reina house.

episodes.name: Episode 312
episodes.overview: After hesitation, Digna and Don Pedro make a decision regarding their wedding plans. María informs the De la Reinas of her decision regarding the sale of the shares.

episodes.name: Episode 313
episodes.overview: Andrés is determined to investigate Jesús's relationship with Górriz. After the van incident, Don Pedro demands that Tasio and Marta be held accountable.

episodes.name: Episode 314
episodes.overview: Andrés is determined to find Górriz to clarify what happened. He and Begoña doubt whether Jesús really committed suicide.

episodes.name: Episode 315
episodes.overview: Don Pedro gives in to Don Agustín's pressure and will marry Digna and Pedro. Joaquín and Luis want to do something fun with Teo so he won't be so sad.

episodes.name: Episode 316
episodes.overview: Claudia, disappointed with Raúl after learning that he has fallen in love with María, decides to distance herself from the driver.

episodes.name: Episode 317
episodes.overview: Raúl tries to defend his relationship with María to Claudia. Begoña receives a disturbing anonymous message.

episodes.name: Episode 318
episodes.overview: Begoña accuses María of being behind the anonymous note. María warns Sergeant Pontón about Begoña's possible lie in her alibi.

episodes.name: Episode 319
episodes.overview: Sergeant Pontón harshly interrogates Begoña. Marta tries to warn Doña Clara about the Montesquinza real estate scam.

episodes.name: Episode 320
episodes.overview: Damián summons Pontón, ready to accuse Don Pedro, but the sergeant reveals that it was a woman who called accusing Begoña. Luz tries to calm Begoña down.

episodes.name: Episode 321
episodes.overview: Begoña supports Andrés in his initiative to kick María out of the house, and also confronts her. Irene, aware of his discontent, asks Pedro to take better care of his relationship with Tasio.

episodes.name: Episode 322
episodes.overview: Damián is plagued by guilt over how he ignored his brother Bernardo in the past. María, forced to leave the house, says goodbye to Raúl.

episodes.name: Episode 323
episodes.overview: Damián learns of María's accident. She has recovered but remains unconscious. Luis and Luz are the first Merino members to learn of María's accident.

episodes.name: Episode 324
episodes.overview: Manuela goes to the hospital worried to find out how María is doing and try to cheer her up.

episodes.name: Episode 325
episodes.overview: During Gema's visit to the hospital, Luz gives María some difficult news about her test results.

episodes.name: Episode 326
episodes.overview: After María's manipulation, Raúl resents Andrés: he believes it was premeditated. Damián learns from Sergeant Pontón that he has lost track of Górriz.

episodes.name: Episode 327
episodes.overview: Digna tells Don Pedro the accusations Damián made against him. Damián tells his children that they are going to meet their cousin Gabriel.

episodes.name: Episode 328
episodes.overview: Irene hides from Don Pedro that she has discovered who Cristina really is. María manipulates Andrés and makes him believe he can rebuild his life.

episodes.name: Episode 329
episodes.overview: Raúl, ignoring Manuela's advice, confronts Andrés and accuses him of being responsible for María's fall. Carmen's brother, Chema, arrives at the colony.

episodes.name: Episode 330
episodes.overview: Andrés discovers that Raúl is in love with María. Damián is determined to intervene between Andrés and María to prevent his son from being annihilated under his wife's shadow.

episodes.name: Episode 331
episodes.overview: After María's insistence, Raúl decides to stay... but he needs Andrés's approval. María is relieved to learn that Andrés has ended his relationship with Begoña.

episodes.name: Episode 332
episodes.overview: Digna reveals to Don Pedro and Irene who Gabriel is and what his relationship is with the De la Reinas. Begoña, devastated by her breakup with Andrés, seeks support from Luz.

episodes.name: Episode 333
episodes.overview: Gabriel is aware of the tension between Tasio and Damián. To María's delight, Begoña and Andrés continue to grow apart.

episodes.name: Episode 334
episodes.overview: Luz, guilty about standing up to Gema, decides to reveal an important secret about her past so she'll forgive her. Pedro tries to find out more about Gabriel's past.

episodes.name: Episode 335
episodes.overview: María tries to take her own life in response to Andrés's proposal to be admitted to a nursing home.

episodes.name: Episode 336
episodes.overview: The day of Luz's exam arrives! And the Merino family encourages her and wishes her luck. Begoña suspects that María tried to take her own life solely to manipulate Andrés.

episodes.name: Episode 337
episodes.overview: Gabriel goes ahead with his plan and tricks the De la Reinas into believing he's helping them solve the van accident. Begoña suspects there may be something going on between María and Raúl.

episodes.name: Episode 338
episodes.overview: Damián makes Gabriel an important job offer. Luz confesses to Begoña that she'll quit medicine if she doesn't pass the exam.

episodes.name: Episode 339
episodes.overview: Don Pedro asks Marta about Pelayo and what his aspirations are. Chema's neck injury forces him to return to his sister's house... much to Tasio's annoyance.

episodes.name: Episode 340
episodes.overview: Luis is concerned about Joaquín's investigation into Don Pedro. Gabriel uses all his gift of the gab to convince Don Pedro to hire him.

episodes.name: Episode 341
episodes.overview: Finally, Gabriel gets his way and gets his position as lawyer for Perfumerías De la Reina.

episodes.name: Episode 342
episodes.overview: Joaquín apologizes to Don Pedro for what happened during dinner and thanks him for his actions during Jesús's death. Begoña offers to choose a nurse for María.

episodes.name: Episode 343
episodes.overview: Andrés suspects that Raúl's departure has something to do with María, but she tries to deny it. Cristina discovers Gabriel snooping around the lab.

episodes.name: Episode 344
episodes.overview: María asks Andrés to sleep with her again. Will he agree? Begoña is the victim of a robbery at the clinic!

episodes.name: Episode 345
episodes.overview: Begoña has been injured after the robbery at the clinic. Gabriel steals Cristina's laboratory keys. Fina confesses her fears about motherhood to Marta.

episodes.name: Episode 346
episodes.overview: Don Pedro demands a firm hand against the thief who attacked the clinic. Fina understands, thanks to Teo, that she can be a good mother.

episodes.name: Episode 347
episodes.overview: Begoña is upset with Andrés for not wanting to help her withdraw the complaint against the dispensary thief.

episodes.name: Episode 348
episodes.overview: María is inwardly upset when she realizes that Andrés still loves Begoña. Teo finds Gema's heart pills and worries that what happened to his mother might happen again.

episodes.name: Episode 349
episodes.overview: Damián tries to approach Irene, but she remains elusive. Damián hasn't been informed about Raúl's hiring as a mechanic and demands an explanation.

episodes.name: Episode 350
episodes.overview: After his meeting with Begoña, Gabriel asks Don Pedro to withdraw the complaint against the thief who attacked the dispensary.

episodes.name: Episode 351
episodes.overview: Begoña catches María checking the sensitivity of her legs, and she tries to hide it. After feeling attracted to him, Irene shares her feelings with Digna.

episodes.name: Episode 352
episodes.overview: María continues to hide her improvement in her disability. Cristina gives Tasio the altered perfume formula for the Cobeaga collection.

episodes.name: Episode 353
episodes.overview: Luis scolds Cristina for the perfume production failure. To Andrés's surprise, Don Pedro defends Cristina tooth and nail.

episodes.name: Episode 354
episodes.overview: Marta tells Fina about her decision not to have a child with Pelayo. Begoña feels overwhelmed by Gabriel's insistence.

episodes.name: Episode 355
episodes.overview: Cristina reveals to Luis the truth about her origins and the perfumer advises her to give Doña Ana a chance to explain herself.

episodes.name: Episode 356
episodes.overview: Andrés apologizes to Begoña for his behavior toward Gabriel. Cristina has made a decision regarding the relationship she wants to maintain with Doña Ana.

episodes.name: Episode 357
episodes.overview: Andrés is jealous of Gabriel's success in winning Julia over, and tries to assert himself. Luis tries to convince Cristina not to leave the colony.

episodes.name: Episode 358
episodes.overview: Gaspar is very excited after his night with Manuela, and wants to make plans with her. Does she feel the same?

episodes.name: Episode 359
episodes.overview: Andrés tries to contain his anger when he realizes that Gabriel continues to win over Begoña. Irene opens up to Damián, and he takes a step forward in their relationship.

episodes.name: Episode 360
episodes.overview: Tensions rise between Gabriel and Begoña. Digna encourages Don Pedro to go to the doctor because he's very tired, but he refuses.

episodes.name: Episode 361
episodes.overview: Andrés asks Luz about Begoña's relationship with Gabriel and Begoña can no longer resist his charms.

episodes.name: Episode 362
episodes.overview: Andrés reveals to Damián his suspicions about a possible relationship between Begoña and Gabriel. Gabriel tells María about his kiss with Begoña.

episodes.name: Episode 363
episodes.overview: María senses the distance between Andrés and Begoña. Begoña tells Gabriel that Andrés already knows what happened between them.

episodes.name: Episode 364
episodes.overview: Gabriel invites Begoña to a party at the Toledo Casino. María asks Gabriel to make his relationship with Begoña official to everyone else.

episodes.name: Episode 365
episodes.overview: Andrés asks Cristina questions about her relationship with Gabriel. Claudia makes Manuela believe she needs to be honest with Gaspar.

episodes.name: Episode 366
episodes.overview: María informs Andrés that Begoña and Gabriel's relationship is official. Gabriel seeks to win Julia's approval of his relationship with Begoña.

episodes.name: Episode 367
episodes.overview: Gabriel, after the argument with Andrés, asks Cristina for an explanation. Gema and Joaquín don't know what to do about Teo's behavior.

episodes.name: Episode 368
episodes.overview: Luz struggles with having to keep quiet about Pedro's illness. Andrés and Tasio interrogate Remedios about the patent theft.

episodes.name: Episode 369
episodes.overview: Gabriel realizes that Begoña still has doubts about who really committed the robbery. José, after his conversation with Damián, reconsiders telling Cristina the truth.

episodes.name: Episode 370
episodes.overview: Andrés wants to visit Remedios in prison because he believes in her innocence. Since the situation isn't improving, Gema and Joaquín decide to talk to the bully's parents.

episodes.name: Episode 371
episodes.overview: Gabriel explains to María what he intends by denouncing Brossard. Pedro confronts Damián, blaming him for José's reappearance in their lives.

episodes.name: Episode 372
episodes.overview: After their first night together, Begoña still has many doubts about her relationship with Gabriel. Luz wants to make sure there's nothing going on between Luis and Cristina.

episodes.name: Episode 373
episodes.overview: Luz continues to worry about the workers' respiratory problems. Julia helps Teo solve his problem with the bully.

episodes.name: Episode 374
episodes.overview: Gabriel and Andrés try to make peace. Fina discovers that Santiago has escaped from prison. Don Pedro had something to do with Pepe's arrest.

episodes.name: Episode 375
episodes.overview: Damián tries to persuade Irene not to leave the colony. Digna has gotten the bully expelled from school. Carmen tries to cheer up Tasio.

episodes.name: Episode 376
episodes.overview: Gabriel celebrates with María about the saponification problem. Irene regrets not being able to contact José to get the truth. Gabriel and Begoña move forward in their relationship.

episodes.name: Episode 377
episodes.overview: Fina, cornered, accepts Pelayo's blackmail. María's mobility progresses. Cristina tells Ana the truth about José.

episodes.name: Episode 378
episodes.overview: At the store, Carmen and Claudia miss Fina. The economic crisis the company is facing could have fatal consequences.

episodes.name: Episode 379
episodes.overview: Marta reveals to the girls the reason for Fina's departure. Irene begins to piece together the details surrounding José's disappearance. Fear of illness spreads among the workers.

episodes.name: Episode 380
episodes.overview: Damián tries to calm Pelayo down in the face of the scandal that threatens to engulf him. Digna learns from Gema that Fina is no longer in the colony.

episodes.name: Episode 381
episodes.overview: Cristina begins to notice something troubling about Don Pedro. Irene tries to get closer to Digna, but she's unwilling to forgive. Luz pressures Don Pedro to tell the truth.

episodes.name: Episode 382
episodes.overview: Desperate, Don Pedro tries to retain Digna. Luz makes a decision that shakes the board. Gema, tired of her job at the store, wants a change of scenery.

episodes.name: Episode 383
episodes.overview: Carmen and Claudia receive a letter from Fina.

episodes.name: Episode 384
episodes.overview: Marta confesses to the girls the truth about her relationship with Fina.

episodes.name: Episode 385
episodes.overview: María confesses to Andrés her desire to be a mother.

episodes.name: Episode 386
episodes.overview: The company's crisis continues to grow as Tasio accepts the De la Reina's invitation.

episodes.name: Episode 387
episodes.overview: Irene begins to suspect that her brother is not well and Luz lets slip something disturbing.

episodes.name: Episode 388
episodes.overview: Joaquín can't find the courage to tell Luis the truth about Pedro. Don Pedro and Digna clash over Joaquín's confession.

episodes.name: Episode 389
episodes.overview: Digna rekindles feelings for Damián, but hides the truth about Pedro from him. Luis confesses to Luz that Cristina kissed him.

episodes.name: Episode 390
episodes.overview: Don Pedro's health threatens the family's power structure. A sudden confession changes the tone of Luis and Cristina's already shaky relationship.

episodes.name: Episode 391
episodes.overview: Don Pedro manipulates Digna into hiding her bruise. The threat of closure looms over the factory, sowing uncertainty among the workers.

episodes.name: Episode 392
episodes.overview: Luis tries to reconnect with Luz, but the rejection reveals a rift that's increasingly difficult to hide. The memory of Fina pushes Marta to withdraw into herself.

episodes.name: Episode 393
episodes.overview: Begoña asks Andrés to convince María to cover a critical medical leave at the family home as soon as possible.

episodes.name: Episode 394
episodes.overview: Digna's situation overwhelms her children, who feel powerless at seeing her forced to care for Pedro.

episodes.name: Episode 395
episodes.overview: Damián's appearance at Ángela's funeral does not happen, leaving everyone confused.

episodes.name: Episode 396
episodes.overview: María decides to resume her rehabilitation in Madrid, which raises suspicions about her true intentions.

episodes.name: Episode 397
episodes.overview: Julia tells Begoña that she saw María's shoes untied, and Gabriel becomes tense when he hears her.

episodes.name: Episode 398
episodes.overview: Begoña suspects that María has started walking again and discusses it with Andrés, who also begins to doubt. Tasio thanks Damián for respecting his decision not to attend the funeral.

episodes.name: Episode 399
episodes.overview: Luz confirms that María cannot walk, dispelling Begoña's suspicions. Don Pedro appoints Tasio as the new director of the factory, and Damián communicates the decision to the family.

episodes.name: Episode 400
episodes.overview: Damián doubts whether to report Digna for the death of Jesús and Manuela comforts him without knowing what it's about.

episodes.name: Episode 401
episodes.overview: Don Pedro asks Luz to help him die, he can no longer stand the pain. Tasio reproaches Andrés for the delay in soap production and appears insecure in his position.

episodes.name: Episode 402
episodes.overview: Irene, dismayed after learning about her brother's death, begins to suspect Damián. Digna fears for the consequences that Pedro's death can bring.

episodes.name: Episode 403
episodes.overview: Digna cannot pretend to be sad during Don Pedro's funeral. Pelayo, tired of Marta's mood, demands that she turn the page.

episodes.name: Episode 404
episodes.overview: Gabriel says goodbye to Isabel believing that everything is under control, but she makes an important discovery.

episodes.name: Episode 405
episodes.overview: Isabel discovers Gabriel's true identity. Damián and Pelayo find out that Marta has temporarily stepped away from the company.

episodes.name: Episode 406
episodes.overview: Gabriel wins Isabel over again, promising her a future together if he manages to take over the company.

episodes.name: Episode 407
episodes.overview: Gabriel tries to justify his trips to Madrid. Cristina makes an important confession to Luz about the matter of the kiss with Luis.

episodes.name: Episode 408
episodes.overview: Damián tries to negotiate with Sergeant Zabalza to have José released. José returns to the colony badly injured, leaving everyone shocked.

episodes.name: Episode 409
episodes.overview: Gaspar finds José badly injured. Cristina and Irene reunite with him. Digna wonders whether or not to tell the truth to her nephews.

episodes.name: Episode 410
episodes.overview: Begoña and Andrés conspire to keep the secret of Jesús's death, which annoys Gabriel when he sees them sharing confidences.

episodes.name: Episode 411
episodes.overview: Begoña makes a decision regarding her motherhood. Cristina and José get along like two peas in a pod. José tells Irene how Don Pedro kept him away from her.

episodes.name: Episode 412
episodes.overview: Cristina puts her shares up for sale, which generates Damián's interest. Begoña still has doubts about her pregnancy despite Gabriel's commitment.

episodes.name: Episode 413
episodes.overview: María feels jealous of Begoña: although she is interested in her being pregnant, she cannot help thinking that she will never have children.

episodes.name: Episode 414
episodes.overview: Begoña does not want to rush into agreeing to marry Gabriel. Claudia is unsure about what to do with Raúl. Carmen thanks Damián for the support he gave to Tasio.

episodes.name: Episode 415
episodes.overview: Gabriel discovers that Andrés has visited Remedios and probes him. Raúl says goodbye to Teo, leaving behind a chapter of his life in the colony.

episodes.name: Episode 416
episodes.overview: Andrés has a confrontation with Gabriel, which causes the lawyer to put his plan into motion.

episodes.name: Episode 417
episodes.overview: María expresses her concern to Begoña and Gabriel about Andrés, fearing that the boiler might explode. José suggests to Irene resuming their youthful plans.

episodes.name: Episode 418
episodes.overview: Claudia, Gaspar, and Raúl wonder what the future of Perfumerías de la Reina will be.

episodes.name: Episode 419
episodes.overview: Gabriel returns home with Begoña, who feels guilty that he entered the engine room. Damián collapses when faced with the gravity of the situation.

episodes.name: Episode 420
episodes.overview: Emma Govantes' campaign is halted due to a lack of stock, affecting the plans of the colony.

episodes.name: Episode 421
episodes.overview: Gaspar shares the operators' concerns with Tasio, who remains tight-lipped.

episodes.name: Episode 422
episodes.overview: Tasio receives a strange call that could change the future of the company. Marta asks Pelayo for help to save the company from ruin.

episodes.name: Episode 423
episodes.overview: David, one of the workers in the engine room, runs into Chema in the neighborhood, which leads them to an interesting discovery between them.

episodes.name: Episode 424
episodes.overview: Luz tells the family that Andrés might wake up. Gabriel, driven by fear that Andrés will wake up, makes a risky decision.

episodes.name: Episode 425
episodes.overview: María confronts Gabriel in the hospital. Digna confesses to Luz her fears about Begoña's marriage to Gabriel. Carmen and David catch up.

episodes.name: Episode 426
episodes.overview: Gabriel persuades Begoña to postpone her visit to the hospital, and together they deliver surprising news to the family.

episodes.name: Episode 427
episodes.overview: Andrés begins to recover and to ask himself difficult questions about what happened. A shocking revelation from Digna completely destabilizes Marta emotionally.

episodes.name: Episode 428
episodes.overview: Luz authorizes Begoña to resume her routine, and both are excited about a new joint project. Tasio announces the news about the new business situation.

episodes.name: Episode 429
episodes.overview: Marta takes a step back and reconciles with Digna. Begoña confirms a concerning gap in Andrés's memory.

episodes.name: Episode 430
episodes.overview: Begoña reminds Andrés of his new reality and the choices he has made. Marta hides a disturbing plan that she doesn't want to share with anyone and ventures into dangerous territory.

episodes.name: Episode 431
episodes.overview: Luz warns Begoña to stay away from Andrés's memories if she wants to avoid consequences.

episodes.name: Episode 432
episodes.overview: Cloe bursts into the store with new rules that no one expected. Neither Damián nor María can stop her, and Andrés returns to the place where it all broke out.

episodes.name: Episode 433
episodes.overview: Marta discovers that the store has changed radically without prior notice. Andrés shares with Luis his growing concern about what his mind is hiding from him.

episodes.name: Episode 434
episodes.overview: The first complications begin after the new change in the store. Damián and Digna refuse to accept Begoña's decision.

episodes.name: Episode 435
episodes.overview: Damián changes his mind and surprises Begoña with his new decision. Julia receives news that fills her with happiness.

episodes.name: Episode 436
episodes.overview: Julia excitedly tells her grandmother some great news, but she hides her dissatisfaction with the idea.

episodes.name: Episode 437
episodes.overview: A shocking memory puts Andrés on alert. Tensions arise with the new changes and the latest news about the company.

episodes.name: Episode 438
episodes.overview: Claudia communicates her decision about the orphanage, but soon her plans are thwarted. Digna considers a new possibility that could change her current situation.

episodes.name: Episode 439
episodes.overview: Damián distances himself from Digna and, without meaning to, ends up opening up deeply to the person he least expects. Andrés asks Marta about his new suspicions.

episodes.name: Episode 440
episodes.overview: Digna's hope wavers after some hard-to-accept news. A first meeting between Claudia and David reveals an unexpected connection.

episodes.name: Episode 441
episodes.overview: What begins as an intimate moment between Andrés and Begoña ends in unexpected tension, which once again creates distance.

episodes.name: Episode 442
episodes.overview: Don Agustín crosses a line and Cloe makes it clear that she knows how to defend herself. Digna agrees to help Damián, but upon seeing him, she is surprised by his condition.

episodes.name: Episode 443
episodes.overview: Claudia brings Maripaz on board, not knowing that she will soon be able to influence her decisions. Tensions continue in the store regarding the new perfume.

episodes.name: Episode 444
episodes.overview: Just when everything seemed joyful, Andrés's departure disrupts the balance of the day. The factory faces a serious setback, and Gabriel asks for help.

episodes.name: Episode 445
episodes.overview: Joaquín's initial success is overshadowed by the first setback in his company. Andrés begins to uncover hidden truths about Gabriel.

episodes.name: Episode 446
episodes.overview: Luz begins to worry about Gema's health. Carmen acts distant with Tasio, uneasy about certain behaviors that seem familiar to her.

episodes.name: Episode 447
episodes.overview: Cristina feels relieved talking to Claudia, and Luis tries to cheer her up with a new professional challenge. Joaquín has new ideas for his business and celebrates its launch.

episodes.name: Episode 448
episodes.overview: Andrés's departure not only stirs up past emotions, it also raises concerns in the present after strong statements.

episodes.name: Episode 449
episodes.overview: The De la Reina house receives an unexpected guest. This visit ends up sparking a confrontation that directly involves Gabriel.

episodes.name: Episode 450
episodes.overview: Cristina makes a firm decision after a tense encounter with Beltrán. Suspicions begin to arise about who might be behind the unexpected arrival.

episodes.name: Episode 451
episodes.overview: Cloe confirms a worrying suspicion with Luis and quickly expresses her disappointment to Tasio. An unexpected connection begins to take shape in the De la Reina house.

episodes.name: Episode 452
episodes.overview: Cristina begins to feel overwhelmed by Beltrán's behavior. Begoña witnesses a gesture from Gabriel that makes it clear that something has crossed a line.

episodes.name: Episode 453
episodes.overview: Luz, aware of the risks, doesn't stand idly by and starts looking for the best way to help Gema. Something unexpected happens between Cloe and Marta.

episodes.name: Episode 454
episodes.overview: A secret from the past could be being used as a blackmail weapon in current key matters. After what happened, Cloe approaches Marta to apologize.

episodes.name: Episode 455
episodes.overview: Despite his efforts, Andrés faces a setback and doesn't see a clear path to achieving his goal, at least for now. Gema's decision causes tension and raises unexpected concerns.

episodes.name: Episode 456
episodes.overview: Gaspar's lapses cause Manuela concern, and she suggests he see a doctor, although he denies it. Andrés looks for answers from Delia, but encounters unexpected reproaches.

episodes.name: Episode 457
episodes.overview: Doña Clara announces important news that could mark a before and after for the orphanage. Tasio appears upset about a situation he cannot control.

episodes.name: Episode 458
episodes.overview: Moved by Pelayo's words, Marta opens up to Carmen and shares her inner confusion, which drives her to make a decision.

episodes.name: Episode 459
episodes.overview: Delia suggests to Gabriel the possibility of living nearby, but she soon discovers that he has other plans. Amid confessions, something unexpected happens between Carmen and David.

episodes.name: Episode 460
episodes.overview: Delia learns about new events and finally asks Begoña for help. Driven by the anger of not having been the chosen one, Maripaz makes a decision that affects Claudia.

episodes.name: Episode 461
episodes.overview: In an attempt to make things right, Andrés approaches Begoña. Begoña shares her surprise with Gabriel and receives a very meaningful gift from someone unexpected.

episodes.name: Episode 462
episodes.overview: David and Carmen open up to each other after what happened, and he makes a decision that changes the course of events.

episodes.name: Episode 463
episodes.overview: Gabriel and María share confidences about secrets and unsettling questions that threaten to come to light.

episodes.name: Episode 464
episodes.overview: Andrés questions Gabriel about his trip to Paris, which sparks a heated confrontation between them.

episodes.name: Episode 465
episodes.overview: Damián doubts Andrés's accusations against Gabriel, while Digna becomes alarmed and he himself starts to worry.

episodes.name: Episode 466
episodes.overview: While Marta acknowledges Joaquín's success, Teo tries to share his joy for Gema, provoking mixed reactions.

episodes.name: Episode 467
episodes.overview: Pelayo informs Marta and Doña Clara of his decision after receiving the job offer and seeks to keep Marta out of the conflict with Cárdenas.

episodes.name: Episode 468
episodes.overview: Production begins and Tasio tries to reinstate his colleagues. After an incident, Claudia decides to take action against Maripaz.

episodes.name: Episode 469
episodes.overview: Digna catches up on Gabriel's situation, and everyone tries to hide it, although he begins to suspect.

episodes.name: Episode 470
episodes.overview: Damián finds out about Cristina's new job opportunity and makes her a proposal, but he’s not the only one who has thought about it.

episodes.name: Episode 471
episodes.overview: Concern for Julia grows, and alarms go off in the De la Reina's family. Cristina offers Irene to represent her, but she comes up with another idea.

episodes.name: Episode 472
episodes.overview: Gabriel confesses a secret he has always kept, and when he talks to María, she suggests an exchange of favors that could benefit them both.

episodes.name: Episode 473
episodes.overview: Pelayo tells his mother the decision he has made, but she believes he is making a big mistake and might try to stop him.

episodes.name: Episode 474
episodes.overview: Gabriel confronts Begoña, but she responds firmly, relying on her pregnancy. Marta's diary disappears, and they soon identify the person responsible.

episodes.name: Episode 475
episodes.overview: Gaspar goes to help Claudia and ends up getting involved in an incident with Maripaz. Damián hides the blackmail from his family and makes a decision about it.

episodes.name: Episode 476
episodes.overview: Joaquín makes a decision regarding the offers he had received and decides to sell his shares in Perfumerías de la Reina.

episodes.name: Episode 477
episodes.overview: Damián announces his decision in the face of blackmail and faces the consequences with determination.

episodes.overview: In the not-so-distant future, the Star family creates a reunion episode.

shows.name: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
shows.overview: In the criminal justice system, sexually-based offenses are considered especially heinous. In New York City, the dedicated detectives who investigate these vicious felonies are members of an elite squad known as the Special Victims Unit. These are their stories.

episodes.name: Volition
episodes.overview: When a sexual assault victim struggles to prove her case in court, Benson pursues a controversial strategy to make sure her voice is heard. A meeting with a jury consultant leads Benson down a path that threatens her partnership with Carisi.

episodes.name: Midway
episodes.overview: Curry answers a family's call for help when their son disappears from a carnival. The search uncovers a chilling connection to an old abduction and a tragic chain of events. Benson must balance justice with compassion when the case takes a turn.

episodes.name: Anonymity
episodes.overview: As SVU races to dismantle a dark web network exploiting young children, a conflict with federal investigators threatens the case. Bruno's determination to protect the victims pushes him to a breaking point.

episodes.name: In the Wind
episodes.overview: Danger swirls around the squad as they investigate a suspect for rape and try to protect their key witness. A new chief of detectives puts Benson to the test. An off-duty Fin tries to stop an assault in progress.

episodes.name: A Waiver of Consent
episodes.overview: When a member of an elite social club is assaulted, Carisi must convince witnesses to come forward despite the club's strict confidentiality rules. Chief Tynan offers Benson some extra help. Velasco is confronted with a surprising opportunity.

episodes.name: A Vicious Circle
episodes.overview: Bruno suspects a bomb was planted to destroy DNA evidence in a rape case. Benson takes on a murder investigation connected to the bombing. Griffin experiences the frustrating setbacks of working an SVU case.

episodes.name: Clickbait
episodes.overview: When a tween suffers a life-threatening miscarriage, the SVU must unravel a web of online fabrications to identify a suspect. Rollins carefully weighs her career options.

episodes.name: Feed the Craving
episodes.overview: When a woman in active labor is abducted, Rollins and Curry look to her doula for an account of events. Carisi tries to get a confession in front of the jury.

episodes.name: Under the Influence
episodes.overview: The squad investigates an assault at a house party where no one can identify the assailant. When two suspects are detained for questioning, Rollins takes the chance to turn one against the other.

episodes.name: False Idols
episodes.overview: The SVU must determine fact from fantasy when a famous author twists the details of a serious crime. Fin has a challenging day at work.

episodes.name: Showdown
episodes.overview: When a man claims his girlfriend was kidnapped, Bruno investigates the holes in his story. Tynan comes down hard on Benson after a disagreement. Griffin must defend his police work on the stand.

episodes.name: Purity (II)
episodes.overview:
The hunt for a murder suspect uncovers a crime with shocking legal and ethical implications. Bruno must protect his squad during a raid on a suspect's home. Carisi and Price team up in court when Brady's interrogation tactics undermine the case.

The crossover starts on Law & Order S25E09 Snowflakes (I).

episodes.name: Fidelis Ad Mortem
episodes.overview: When Curry's son finds a disturbing cassette tape in a thrift store haul, she and Benson must investigate a decades-old missing persons case. Griffin learns a disturbing rumor about his father.

episodes.name: Career Psychopath
episodes.overview: When a stranger threatens Rollins and Carisi's lives, they suspect it's connected to a case they worked together. Benson asks an old friend to come out of retirement for help with an investigation.

episodes.name: Hubris
episodes.overview: A teenager rescued from a dangerous situation begs Benson to help reunite her with her father. Carisi and CJ take the foster system to task for separating families without sufficient proof.

episodes.name: Corrosive
episodes.overview: An attempt on a respected judge's life is connected to an anonymous video posted to the SVU tip line. Rollins tries to help a victim come to terms with their abuse.

episodes.name: Frequency
episodes.overview: A family discovers a young boy in grave danger when their baby monitor picks up a rogue frequency. Griffin goes to extremes to find the boy's location. Rollins finds herself alone with a predator.

episodes.name: Thirsty
episodes.overview: Reports of an assault by a guest at a fan convention leads to a murder investigation. Tynan presents Capt. Curry with a career opportunity.

episodes.name: Vivid
episodes.overview: With little evidence to guide them, the SVU steps in when a woman undergoing psychedelic-assisted therapy recovers a buried memory of assault. Curry starts a new position at SVU.

episodes.name: Deep Under
episodes.overview: Benson is shocked to find undercover Detective Velasco at the center of a sex trafficking bust. When more women are smuggled into the city, a rescued victim begs SVU to help save her sister.

episodes.name: Gimmick
episodes.overview: A mysterious death in a hotel leads the squad into the world of professional fighting. Benson tries to convince a victim to come forward for the sake of his friend.

episodes.name: Impropriety
episodes.overview: An unconscious and injured teen abandoned outside a hospital sends the SVU on a search for the people who left her there. Benson faces serious consequences when she chooses to protect a victim's secret under the pressure of cross-examination.

episodes.name: Old Friends
episodes.overview: The squad must untangle conflicting stories and long-buried secrets when a drug-fueled college reunion ends in sexual assault. With the squad under internal pressure by Tynan, Fin keeps the case on track.

episodes.name: Monster
episodes.overview: A procedural mistake made during the rescue of a kidnapped boy causes the case to collapse in court. As Griffin gets closer to the truth about Tynan, he finds himself in grave danger.

shows.name: Law & Order
shows.overview: In cases ripped from the headlines, police investigate serious and often deadly crimes, weighing the evidence and questioning the suspects until someone is taken into custody. The district attorney's office then builds a case to convict the perpetrator by proving the person guilty beyond a reasonable doubt. Working together, these expert teams navigate all sides of the complex criminal justice system to make New York a safer place.

episodes.name: Ghost in the Machine
episodes.overview: A software engineer’s murder sends Riley and Walker into the rapidly-evolving world of AI. As Baxter pursues justice in a groundbreaking case, he’s confronted with a technology advancing faster than the laws designed to govern it.

episodes.name: Into the Mystic
episodes.overview: Price and Walker are forced off a high-stakes case when their connection to a murder suspect creates a conflict of interest. Baxter faces mounting pressure when a key witness for the prosecution suddenly changes their story.

episodes.name: Bad News
episodes.overview: When a prominent newspaper editor is murdered, Calvino and Walker uncover a web of newsroom secrets that obstructs their investigation. Price must weigh the public's right to know against a journalist's duty to protect a source.

episodes.name: Street Justice
episodes.overview: When Brady's squad investigates the death of an exonerated murder suspect, a major lead points to ADA Maroun. Price wrestles with the potential consequences of a guilty verdict.

episodes.name: Hindsight
episodes.overview: Brady and Riley must sort through a list of rivals to pinpoint a suspect when a star music student is murdered on the way home from school. Price finds a surprising name on the defense's witness list.

episodes.name: White Lies
episodes.overview: A bulldog investment fund manager is murdered in the midst of a client's big takeover. Price goes to desperate lengths to prove the suspect's motives.

episodes.name: Two and Twenty
episodes.overview: A billionaire banker is murdered and the 2-7 must investigate his many clients and employees. Price and Maroun struggle to keep the jury's focus on the crime and not the victim's darker side.

episodes.name: Bend the Knee
episodes.overview: A law partner with prominent government clients is murdered. Baxter must consider making political concessions for the case to be a success.

episodes.name: Brotherly Love
episodes.overview: A respected restauranteur with a gambling problem is murdered, and Baxter and Price disagree on the best approach to a conviction. Meanwhile, Riley's brother is released from prison.

episodes.name: Guardian
episodes.overview: When a high school sports star is murdered, the police find several suspects trying to make money off the victim's talent. Riley gets a new partner.

shows.overview: Explore the high-pressure experiences of police officers, paramedics and firefighters who are thrust into the most frightening, shocking and heart-stopping situations. These emergency responders must try to balance saving those who are at their most vulnerable with solving the problems in their own lives.

episodes.name: That Sinking Feeling
episodes.overview: The 118 faces an earth-shattering emergency that shakes the city of Los Angeles to its core. Still finding her footing as a detective, Athena leans on instinct to crack a mysterious new case, while May finds her own confidence in a new job.

episodes.name: Eat the Rich
episodes.overview: In honor of Bobby Nash's sacrifice, the 118 comes together to dedicate the firehouse in his memory. Meanwhile, when a billionaire tech giant is involved in a life-or-death emergency, the team must race to his aid.

episodes.name: Spiraling
episodes.overview: As a geostorm ravages Earth, Athena and Hen's space mission teeters on the edge. On the ground, the 118 battles chaos when technology goes rogue.

episodes.name: The Sky Is Falling
episodes.overview: Athena and Hen face increasing dangers in space as friends both near and far try to get them home safely. Meanwhile, the 118 continues to help victims of the geostorm and falling debris.

episodes.name: Reentry
episodes.overview: As Athena and Hen navigate their way back home, Athena will be forced to confront what it means to live without Bobby.

episodes.name: Día de los Muertos
episodes.overview: The 118's beliefs are put to the test as they respond to emergency calls involving a Jack-o'-lantern and a few more jump scares than they were expecting on Halloween.

episodes.name: Family History
episodes.overview: Athena must revisit a painful part of her past when answering a call for help. Meanwhile, the 118 takes a big step forward.

episodes.name: Secrets
episodes.overview: Hen's attempts at keeping her mysterious health issues private are starting to impact more than just her physical well-being. Meanwhile, Buck and Ravi decide Eddie needs a night out on the town.

episodes.name: War
episodes.overview: Following Hen's firing, Chimney grapples with his decision and how it has affected the team. Meanwhile, a new AI call center assistant, meant to help, has begun to create more complications, and the 118 must intervene.

episodes.name: Fighting Back
episodes.overview: As Hen continues to seek out a diagnosis for her mysterious symptoms, her friends and family rally behind her. Meanwhile, Harry hits a wall in his attempts to complete the academy firefighting exam and looks for some much-needed motivation.

episodes.name: Handle with Care
episodes.overview: Harry's first day as a probie proves to be more challenging than Chimney expects. Meanwhile, Eddie and Hen are called into court over a former patient that brings back some old demons.

episodes.name: Going Once, Going Twice
episodes.overview: Eddie faces an unthinkable personal crisis. Hen and Karen spring into action when thrown into a terrifying situation. The 118 hosts a LAFD charity bachelor auction that brings up a few concerns from Buck.

episodes.name: Dads and Cads (I)
episodes.overview:
Maddie and Buck are blindsided by some unexpected news that turns their world upside down. Meanwhile, Buck and Eddie head to Nashville when they are selected to participate in the national firefighting games.

The crossover continues on 9-1-1: Nashville S01E12 Spirit of the Games (II).

episodes.name: Mother's Boy
episodes.overview: Eddie and Buck's flight back to Los Angeles is cancelled following the National Firefighter Games. Hoping to be home for Hen's birthday, they decide a cross-country road trip is the fastest way, until they get offtrack and Buck goes missing.

episodes.name: D.I.Y.
episodes.overview: As Buck tries to manage the trauma following his kidnapping on his own, May tries to secure her first law internship without the help of her mother.

episodes.name: Pick Your Poison
episodes.overview: Athena is pulled into a mysterious murder investigation when a man arrives at the station to report his own death. Meanwhile, the 118 races to the site of a car crash involving a mother and son.

episodes.name: Where There's Smoke
episodes.overview: The 118 must account for every decision made during a recent fire call when the team's actions are investigated for possible mistakes. Meanwhile, Buck works behind the scenes to support his team as he waits to learn if he can return to the station.

episodes.name: I Got You Babe
episodes.overview: Buck is faced with his past after an electrical emergency call. Meanwhile, Maddie learns to navigate her working relationships now that she has become a supervisor.

episodes.name: Hearts and Flowers
episodes.overview: Following Athena's shooting, the 118 gathers at the hospital awaiting news. Meanwhile, the mastermind behind the trafficking ring is determined to silence Athena and anyone who gets in his way for good.

shows.name: El hormiguero
shows.overview: El Hormiguero is a Spanish television program with a live audience focusing on comedy, science, and politics running since September 2006. It is hosted and produced by screenwriter Pablo Motos. The show aired on Spain's Cuatro channel from launch until June 2011 and is now broadcast on Antena 3. Recurring guests on the show include Luis Piedrahita, Raquel Martos, Marron & "The Man in Black", and puppet ants Trancas and Barrancas. It has proved a ratings success, and has expanded from a weekly 120-minute show to a daily 40-minute show in its third season, which began on September 17, 2007. The show won the Entertainment prize at the 2009 Rose d'Or ceremony.

episodes.overview: Team Issylra must battle a strange shadow entity in order to find a way home, but plans stall when a shocking revelation rocks the group to its core...

episodes.name: Mist and Whimsy
episodes.overview: Bells Hells travel to the fog shrouded islands of the Shattered Teeth and meet several of the unusual denizens of the chaotic land...

episodes.name: Phantasmal Parley

episodes.name: Roots Between Worlds
episodes.overview: Bells Hells explore the island of Kalutha and prepare themselves to take counsel from the fated wisdom of the Great Tree of Atrophy...

episodes.name: An Ancient Flame

episodes.name: A Gathering of Heroes
episodes.overview: Bells Hells return to Whitestone in search of allies and refuge, taking time to reflect on the weight of their choices and the path ahead...

episodes.name: The Eve of the Red Moon
episodes.overview: Bells Hells ponder fey bargains and prepare for their dangerous race through Ruby Vanguard territory...

episodes.overview: Bells Hells stumble upon a secret entrance to Exandria from Ruidus, but this lucky portal leads to a place just as dangerous as the one waiting for them in the sky...

episodes.name: Broken Roads

episodes.name: Bittersweet Reunions

episodes.name: Gathering of Needs

episodes.name: Ancient Sins

episodes.name: The Nox Engine
episodes.overview: Live at the Greek Theatre! Bells Hells battle the creeping terror of an unleashed demon, but their own darkest thoughts may prove to be the real enemy...

episodes.name: Downfall (2)
episodes.overview: The Divine continue their infiltration of Aeor, looking deeper into the city's flaws and virtues as they seek out the center of its hubris...

episodes.name: Downfall (3)

episodes.name: Reconciliation
episodes.overview: Bells Hells contemplate the revelations of the Occultus Thalamus while one of their own is brought low by darkness and desire...

episodes.name: Cages
episodes.overview: Bells Hells seek a way to cut Delilah's puppet strings once and for all...

episodes.name: Assault on the Malleus Key
episodes.overview: With allies in tow and an army at their backs, Vox Machina begin their assault on the Malleus Fortress...

episodes.name: Fight for the Bloody Bridge
episodes.overview: Vox Machina assail the Malleus Key, intent on rescuing the trapped Vax’ildan as enemies attack from all sides…

episodes.name: To the Arx Creonum
episodes.overview: Bells Hells and the Mighty Nein wait in the shadows of the moon city before launching an explosive attack on the Weavemind’s stronghold…

episodes.name: The Weave Mind
episodes.overview: The Mighty Nein steal their way through the Arx Creonum to confront the psychic minds that control the Ruidian populace...

episodes.name: Race to the Ruidian Core
episodes.overview: Bells Hells delve into the fungal network of Ruidus, seeking Ludinus, Liliana, and the Hallowed Cage...
