episodes.name: Viewer DMs
episodes.overview: In this follow up to the "Viewer Mail" episodes, the Griffin family retells The Lord of the Rings, explains how the Griffins' ancestors arrived in Quahog, and looks back at Quagmire's 1960s variety show.

episodes.name: Scent of a Woman
episodes.overview: Brian discovers his nose can detect diseases and smells that someone in the Griffin house has cancer.

episodes.name: Play Time
episodes.overview: In this three-act parody, the Griffins spoof the stage by putting up To Kill a Mockingbird, The Odd Couple and Hamlet.

episodes.name: Phony Montana
episodes.overview: After going on a date with a Cuban-American woman named Carmen, Brian inexplicably develops a Cuban accent- which he worries will hurt his chances with her.

episodes.name: A Few More Ways to Die in the West
episodes.overview: In this Griffin family spoof of the Old West, Peter, known as Quiet Burp, and his gang of outlaws agree to escort a wealthy businessman on a train journey.

episodes.name: Tall Stewie
episodes.overview: When Stewie puts on a pair of boots that make him slightly taller, his newfound confidence changes the power dynamic in the Griffin family.

episodes.name: Lower G.I. Joe
episodes.overview: A colonoscopy reveals Peter has a rare collectible toy action figure lodged in his intestine, but the reward for selling it causes a rift between him and the guys.

episodes.name: Friend's Best Man
episodes.overview: Stewie becomes engaged to Rupert, but Brian is upset when he is not chosen as the best man.

episodes.name: Let the Goodtimes Walk
episodes.overview: A powerful sleeping aid medication gives Joe the ability to walk while he is asleep, but Joe grows concerned when it becomes clear that the guys prefer his sleepwalking self.

episodes.name: High School History
episodes.overview: In this three-act parody of prominent historical eras, the Griffins take a humorous look at The French Revolution, the American Civil War, and World War II.

episodes.name: Fat Gun
episodes.overview: This "Top Gun" parody chronicles Peter/Maverick getting together with Lois/Charlie, the tragic death of Joe/Goose, and Peter/Maverick's blooming relationship with Chris/Rooster.

episodes.name: Live, Laugh, Love
episodes.overview: When Peter realizes Joe has never found him funny, he is determined to make Joe laugh; Lois chaperones Chris and Meg's school trip, where she strives to reunite the principal with his long-lost love.

episodes.name: Drunk with Power
episodes.overview: Peter swaps lives with Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh and is forced to make a ruling on the constitutionality of gay marriage, meanwhile, Brett tries to become friends with Quagmire, Cleveland and Joe.

episodes.name: Lois C.K.
episodes.overview: Lois becomes a stand-up comic, using real life stories about Peter as content; Peter tries his best to straighten his life out to avoid being ridiculed by Lois's act.

episodes.name: The Chicken or the Meg
episodes.overview: Meg starts dating a chicken she meets on a reality dating show.

episodes.name: Dog Is My Co-Pilot
episodes.overview: After successfully landing a plane, Brian and Quagmire go on a press tour. Meanwhile Chris and Stewie open a boutique pizza place.

episodes.name: Pitch Imperfect
episodes.overview: Peter must gain his family's respect back after he makes a humiliating throw. Brian and Stewie become chiropractors.

episodes.name: Hard Times at Adam West High
episodes.overview: Chris uses Stewie's time machine to stop himself from having an erection during a book report. Peter becomes jealous when he sits out of a lottery pool and the guys win.

episodes.name: The Elle Word
episodes.overview: When Quagmire starts dating a mystery woman, Peter, Joe and Cleveland go on a stakeout and discover her to be the librarian.

episodes.name: A Real Who's Hulu
episodes.overview: The Griffins spoof "Only Murders in the Building," "The Dropout," and "The Bear."

episodes.name: China Doll
episodes.overview: When Stewie sees a tag on Rupert reading "Made in China," he heads off to China to meet Rupert's family.

episodes.name: One Foot in Front of the Mother
episodes.overview: Due to a police complaint about his excessive barking, Brian has to wear a shock collar; looking to join an after-school team, Chris discovers a talent for speed walking.

episodes.name: The Fat Lotus
episodes.overview: In this Griffin-family twist on the popular HBO series, Peter suspects Lois of betraying his trust with Quagmire at a swanky vacation, while Stewie worries that his wealthy new friends plan to sacrifice him in a volcano.

episodes.name: Cool Hand Lois
episodes.overview: Lois embarks on a journey of self-discovery.

episodes.name: Martian Meg
episodes.overview: Fed up with feeling like she doesn't belong, Meg enlists in a training program for a mission to Mars.

episodes.name: Row v. Wade
episodes.overview: Brian wins a boat on "The Price is Right" and decides to sail to Texas to help women seeking legal abortions.

episodes.name: Karenheit 451
episodes.overview: Lois becomes the leader of a group of mothers who want to ban books from schools.

episodes.name: Twain's World
episodes.overview: In an effort to improve his writing, Brian convinces Stewie to go back in time and bring Mark Twain to the present day, but the plan goes awry when Twain overindulges in pornography.

shows.name: Daredevil: Born Again
shows.overview: Matt Murdock, a blind lawyer with heightened abilities, is fighting for justice through his bustling law firm, while former mob boss Wilson Fisk pursues his own political endeavors in New York. When their past identities begin to emerge, both men find themselves on an inevitable collision course.

episodes.name: The Northern Star
episodes.overview: Daredevil is in hiding, but he isn't laying low. A shadowy player from Washington, D.C. emerges.

episodes.name: Shoot the Moon
episodes.overview: Fisk tries a new tactic to lure Daredevil out of hiding.

episodes.name: The Scales & the Sword
episodes.overview: Matt Murdock and Karen Page find new allies.

episodes.name: Gloves Off
episodes.overview: Bullseye adopts a new morning routine. Fisk takes the ring.

episodes.name: The Grand Design
episodes.overview: The Anti-Vigilante Task Force intensifies its search for Daredevil and Bullseye.

episodes.name: Requiem
episodes.overview: Fisk's operation is dealt an irrevocable blow. The resistance spills over into the streets.

episodes.name: The Hateful Darkness
episodes.overview: A trial close to Matt Murdock's heart grabs the city's attention.

episodes.name: The Southern Cross
episodes.overview: The city and its heroes enter an unprecedented era.

episodes.name: Heaven's Half Hour
episodes.overview: Matt Murdock gives up the mask. Wilson Fisk has his sights set to new heights.

episodes.name: Optics
episodes.overview: Matt Murdock gets a new client who's more than he claims to be. Fisk learns the power of optics.

episodes.name: The Hollow of His Hand
episodes.overview: The trial of Hector Ayala begins. Fisk's old business associates seek to claim his vacant mantle.

episodes.name: Sic Semper Systema
episodes.overview: Matt Murdock and Wilson Fisk's darker halves fight to be unleashed.

episodes.name: With Interest
episodes.overview: A day in the life of Matt Murdock gets intense, forcing him to team up with a familiar face.

episodes.name: Excessive Force
episodes.overview: When a serial killer terrorizes the streets of New York, the city needs a savior.

episodes.name: Art for Art's Sake
episodes.overview: Daredevil is back and races Fisk to stop Muse from killing again.

episodes.name: Isle of Joy
episodes.overview: At his inaugural Black and White Ball, Mayor Fisk tightens his grip on New York City.

episodes.name: Straight to Hell
episodes.overview: Mayor Fisk becomes Mayor Kingpin, and Daredevil is unleashed as chaos takes over the city.

shows.name: The Rookie
shows.overview: Starting over isn't easy, especially for small-town guy John Nolan who, after a life-altering incident, is pursuing his dream of being an LAPD officer. As the force's oldest rookie, he's met with skepticism from some higher-ups who see him as just a walking midlife crisis.

episodes.name: Czech Mate
episodes.overview: The LAPD, FBI and Interpol work with Monica Stevens in Prague to target high-value terrorists operating within and outside the United States.

episodes.name: Fast Andy
episodes.overview: When the president visits Los Angeles, the LAPD teams up with the Secret Service to ensure his safety and assess any major threats on their watch list. Meanwhile, Miles's instincts are tested, and Tim takes on a new role.

episodes.name: The Red Place
episodes.overview: Nolan makes a quiet arrest, and Lucy and Celina race to rescue a kidnapping victim. Meanwhile, Harper and Lopez help outsmart a killer, and Miles visits a familiar face.

episodes.name: Cut and Run
episodes.overview: While out in the city, Nolan and Bailey witness a murder in public and immediately spring into action in the hopes of finding the person responsible. Meanwhile, Angela and Wesley have a big life decision that may affect their future.

episodes.name: The Network
episodes.overview: Lieutenant Grey and the FBI task force enlist the help of an old colleague to uncover a criminal network. Nolan, Miles, Lucy, and Celina respond to a mysterious officer-involved shooting.

episodes.name: Burn 4 Love
episodes.overview: It's Valentine's Day, and the team is on the hunt for someone who is setting more than hearts on fire. Meanwhile, Celina thinks Miles' recent string of bad luck is the result of a curse, and she's determined to break it.

episodes.name: Baja
episodes.overview: Harper and Lucy go undercover in Baja while investigating the murder of two young women. Back in LA, Bradford and the FBI task force assist in the investigation, while Nolan and Bailey navigate their long-distance relationship.

episodes.name: Grand Theft Aircraft
episodes.overview: Nolan and Garza lead a high-stakes operation that quickly goes south. Lucy and Tim navigate their relationship when an unexpected visitor shows up. Meanwhile, the team conducts a citywide search for a suspect.

episodes.name: Fun and Games
episodes.overview: Harper and Miles feel the weight of their recent mistakes, while Harper is tasked with training Miles. Nolan and Celina are dispatched to a robbery call where Nolan encounters a familiar face.

episodes.name: His Name Was Martin
episodes.overview: Nolan, Harper and Miles face a dangerous situation when a routine check takes a sudden turn. Meanwhile, Bailey conducts a covert investigation at the Pentagon at the request of Lt. Grey.

episodes.name: Aftermath
episodes.overview: Lucy returns to work in the aftermath of the attack. Meanwhile, an unexpected twist hinders the Liam Glasser case, and a familiar face helps the team track down a killer.

episodes.name: Spy Games
episodes.overview: The FBI and LAPD join forces on a covert sting operation to protect Bailey, while Wesley and Angela face tensions in their marriage when his campaign is threatened by a public scandal.

episodes.name: The Thinker
episodes.overview: Bailey gets a new role, and a ride-along with Nolan goes awry. Meanwhile, the team looks to recruit new members.

episodes.name: Tiger Bear
episodes.overview: A troubling incident at a school draws the team into a complex case, while Celina's temporary missing persons assignment leads her into a dangerous situation.

episodes.name: Survive the Streets
episodes.overview: The team works together after Nolan and Celina discover a possible suicide that spirals into conspiracy.

episodes.name: Out of Time
episodes.overview: Nolan is put to the test when he's forced to protect a man he doesn't trust. Meanwhile, Lucy and Celina follow a promising lead, and Lopez finds herself conflicted about Wesley's new position.

episodes.name: Dead Ringer
episodes.overview: Nolan and Harper try to help a desperate mother protect her child, while Lt. Grey and Garza continue to work with Monica despite their misgivings.

episodes.name: The Bandit
episodes.overview: The team launches a high-stakes search to take down a notorious criminal. Meanwhile, Lucy's leadership is tested, Wesley tests the boundaries of his friendships, and Nolan tries to balance duty and family.

shows.name: The Pitt
shows.overview: The staff of Pittsburgh's Trauma Medical Center work around the clock to save lives in an overcrowded and underfunded emergency department.

episodes.name: 7:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: On July 4th, Robby meets his replacement for his upcoming sabbatical, and a familiar face returns to the Pitt.

episodes.name: 8:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: While nervously awaiting her deposition, King takes a tumble. Al-Hashimi tries to introduce new technology into the ER.

episodes.name: 9:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: After a motorcycle collision, a husband and wife find themselves in the ER. Later, Robby bonds with a Tree of Life survivor.

episodes.name: 10:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: With a nearby hospital shuttered on the busiest day of the year, Robby and team must field extra patients, including the victim of a parkour mishap.

episodes.name: 11:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: As patients continue to pour in, including a local prison inmate, Robby and Langdon must work together to save a beloved patient.

episodes.name: 12:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: As the team deals with a loss, Al-Hashimi and Robby continue to clash over the best course of treatment for a patient showing signs of malnutrition.

episodes.name: 1:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: While Dana tends to a sexual assault victim, Abbot helps an officer injured in the field, and Mohan attempts to keep her uninsured patient in the ER.

episodes.name: 2:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: In the wake of an IT shutdown, Princess must manage a completely analog ER. Al-Hashimi, Mohan, and King assess a woman with sudden blindness.

episodes.name: 3:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: After one of Javadi's patients slips through the cracks, Dana calls in an old friend with experience running a low-tech ER.

episodes.name: 4:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: After an incident at a nearby water park, several critical patients are rushed to the Pitt. Later, Al-Hashimi confronts Robby.

episodes.name: 5:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: While King struggles to cope with her sister's newfound independence, patients and staff are put on edge by an unexpected presence in the ER.

episodes.name: 6:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: After she steps up to defend her trainee, Dana clashes with Robby about her methods – and his upcoming sabbatical.

episodes.name: 7:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: As the night shift begins, Mohan's AMA patient is brought back to the ER, Langdon doubts his place in the Pitt, and Robby gets Duke's results.

episodes.name: 8:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: After his bike takes a hit in the ambulance bay, Robby levels with Duke. A spinal cord injury forces Langdon to attempt a risky procedure.

episodes.name: 9:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: Al-Hashimi reveals details from her medical history, forcing Robby to face an ethical dilemma as he prepares to leave for his sabbatical.

shows.name: Shrinking
shows.overview: Jimmy is struggling to grieve the loss of his wife while being a dad, friend, and therapist. He decides to try a new approach with everyone in his path: unfiltered, brutal honesty. Will it make things better—or unleash uproarious chaos?

episodes.name: My Bad
episodes.overview: Jimmy grapples with being an empty nester and feeling torn about Alice's major life choice. Paul faces fresh challenges with his Parkinson's.

episodes.name: Happiness Mission
episodes.overview: The gang unites to support Paul during a health setback. Jimmy and Alice help Louis take a big step. Liz and Derek make a tough choice.

episodes.name: D-Day
episodes.overview: Jimmy and Liz show up for Brian and Charlie when Ava goes into labor. Sean reconnects with his ex Marisol.

episodes.name: The Field
episodes.overview: Gaby invites Jimmy to speak to her class. When Derek ends up in the hospital, Liz has issues with their son. Paul has an important realization.

episodes.name: Hold Your Horsies
episodes.overview: Jimmy and Meg unite over their love for Paul. Gaby considers her future with Derrick #2. Marisol pushes Sean and Alice out of their comfort zones.

episodes.name: Dereks Don't Die
episodes.overview: When Derek's health takes a turn for the worse, Jimmy helps Liz cope. Meg comes clean with Paul. Gaby makes progress with Maya.

episodes.name: I Will Be Grape
episodes.overview: Alice and Jimmy celebrate Tia's birthday. Liz's mother-in-law visits. Paul ponders his legacy.

episodes.name: Depression Diet
episodes.overview: Jimmy finally goes on a first date with Sofi. Gaby has a crisis of confidence. Liz learns more about Brian's living situation.

episodes.name: Daddy Issues
episodes.overview: Jimmy is stressed out by his father's presence. Sean grapples with the fallout of his decision. Paul helps Gaby start something new.

episodes.name: The Bodyguard of Sadness
episodes.overview: The gang celebrates Alice's graduation, as Jimmy struggles with unresolved feelings. Liz and Derek differ on what their future should look like.

episodes.name: And That's Our Time
episodes.overview: As Alice heads to college, Jimmy tries to repair things before it's too late. Gaby makes a happy discovery.

episodes.name: Jimmying
episodes.overview: Jimmy grapples with his guilt over Grace. Paul makes a decision about his relationship. Liz tries to help Gaby find balance in her busy life.

episodes.name: I Love Pain
episodes.overview: Paul and Jimmy disagree about Sean's treatment plan. Gaby's sister asks for her help. Liz has an idea for boosting business at the food truck.

episodes.overview: Jimmy and Brian help Grace deal with unexpected news. Paul and Julie face her past. Liz worries she's come between Sean and his dad.

episodes.name: Made You Look
episodes.overview: Paul challenges Jimmy to show restraint with Sean. Derek introduces Gaby to a friend. Liz advises Brian about parenthood.

episodes.name: Honesty Era
episodes.overview: Jimmy helps Alice cope with a huge mistake. Gaby goes home for a family crisis. Liz runs into an old flame.

episodes.name: In a Lonely Place
episodes.overview: Paul and Jimmy look for Sean's dad. Gaby tries to keep Liz from sinking. Alice is surprised to find out who Brian has been spending time with.

episodes.name: Get in the Sea
episodes.overview: Jimmy spends the day with a patient. Brian crashes Gaby's date. Liz heads down a dangerous path.

episodes.name: Last Drink
episodes.overview: Jimmy faces Alice's secret. Liz and Derek are at a crossroads. Paul worries about his health.

episodes.name: Full Grown Dude Face
episodes.overview: While trying to stay out of Alice's business, Jimmy has to "Jimmy" an insecure Brian. Gaby leans on Paul for advice after her sister drops a bomb.

episodes.name: Changing Patterns
episodes.overview: Jimmy tries to give Alice the perfect 18th birthday. Paul helps Gaby with a huge decision.

episodes.name: The Drugs Don't Work
episodes.overview: Paul encourages Jimmy to seek help. Brian and Derek take Sean to look for a new place. Gaby struggles with her guest list for Thanksgiving.

episodes.name: The Last Thanksgiving
episodes.overview: Jimmy takes Paul's advice about Alice. Liz finally finds her purpose. Gaby hosts Thanksgiving dinner.

shows.name: ONE PIECE
shows.overview: With his straw hat and ragtag crew, young pirate Monkey D. Luffy goes on an epic voyage for treasure.

episodes.name: THE BEGINNING AND THE END
episodes.overview: To prepare for the Grand Line, the Straw Hats visit Loguetown, birthplace of the Great Pirate Era — where rivals both old and new await.

episodes.name: GOOD WHALE HUNTING
episodes.overview: When the Merry lands in the belly of a giant whale, Luffy must win over a gruff lighthouse keeper to save his friends and his ship.

episodes.name: WHISKY BUSINESS
episodes.overview: The crew receives a warm welcome to the pirate-loving town of Whisky Peak. But with a pair of assassins on the loose, trouble isn't far behind.

episodes.name: BIG TROUBLE IN LITTLE GARDEN
episodes.overview: A new addition to the ship raises the stakes. On the lush isle of Little Garden, the crew encounters an adventure of giant proportions.

episodes.name: WAX ON, WAX OFF
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats are held captive by two artists: one who colors emotions, and one intent on making them part of his latest — and deadliest — masterwork.

episodes.name: NAMI DEEREST
episodes.overview: When Nami is stricken by a mysterious illness, Luffy and Sanji embark on a perilous mission to save her. Smoker and Tashigi investigate a Marine outpost.

episodes.name: REINDEER SHAMES
episodes.overview: Dr. Kureha tells the heartwrenching story of Chopper's origins, including how he met his mentor Dr. Hiriluk and their quest to cure all disease.

episodes.name: DEER AND LOATHING IN DRUM KINGDOM
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats lend themselves to Drum Island's cause when King Wapol and his army of monsters return to reclaim the throne.

shows.name: The Lincoln Lawyer
shows.overview: Hotshot LA defense attorney Mickey Haller will do whatever it takes to win as he navigates the criminal justice system from his trademark Lincoln.

episodes.overview: Mickey challenges the dubious traffic stop that landed him behind bars, as Haller and Associates strains under the weight of his looming murder trial.

episodes.name: Baja
episodes.overview: A combative bail hearing puts Mickey in the crosshairs of the Sheriff's Department. Cisco hatches a sweet scheme to bypass a backlog at the crime lab.

episodes.name: Forty Hours
episodes.overview: Mickey and Cisco race against time to pursue a mysterious lead. Lorna scours the fine print to score a win for her client. The firm hires a new driver.

episodes.name: Bleeding the Beast
episodes.overview: A court order compelling the release of records connected to the victim rouses Mickey's worst fears. Maggie confronts a former colleague.

episodes.name: You're the One That I Want

episodes.overview: Secrets surface as Mickey cross-examines a key witness. Lorna gets a new case. Cisco hightails it to Palm Springs to serve a subpoena.

episodes.name: Confirmation Bias
episodes.overview: Mickey fears for his safety in the wake of a violent incident. Eyewitness testimony rattles Lorna's confidence. Izzy grills a green-energy expert.

episodes.overview: Maggie goes full McFierce as she locks horns with a volatile witness. A video shakes up Lorna's pretrial hearing. Mickey contemplates the unthinkable.

episodes.name: La Culebra
episodes.overview: Mickey deliberates over representing the person accused of killing Gloria Dayton. Hayley asks her dad for help when her old babysitter is arrested.

episodes.name: Special Circumstances
episodes.overview: With everyone rattled by his dangerous new case, Mickey faces a major blow when an armed robbery trial turns violent. Julian's bail hearing hits a snag.

episodes.name: Strange Bedfellows
episodes.overview: While Lorna takes the bar exam, Mickey deals with a long-shot motion, a surprise subpoena and a skittish source. Andrea contends with a sensitive case.

episodes.name: Rearview Blind Spots
episodes.overview: Struggling with guilt as he tries to connect the dots in Gloria's murder, Mickey seeks advice from an old friend. Andrea receives devastating news.

episodes.name: What Happens in Victorville
episodes.overview: As Mickey sets a daring plan in motion involving a cartel boss, Lorna urges him to reach out to a besieged Andrea. Cisco tracks a witness in Las Vegas.

episodes.name: Man on Fire
episodes.overview: Mickey's team sets a trap as Julian's trial begins. Hayley blames her dad for a tragic loss, and Lorna receives her bar exam results.

episodes.name: Relevance
episodes.overview: A brutal day in court throws Mickey off his game. Lorna's new case sends her racing through the courthouse. Andrea confides in the wrong person.

episodes.name: Mystery Man
episodes.overview: When the judge rules a pivotal witness can testify, Mickey hatches a desperate plan to get a video admitted into evidence. Izzy gets a huge opportunity.

episodes.name: Ghosts
episodes.overview: With his client's fate uncertain and the DA demanding a mistrial, Mickey goes out on a legal limb to help sway the judge into letting the case continue.

episodes.name: The Gods of Guilt
episodes.overview: In a shocking twist, the missing pieces of Gloria's murder come together on the witness stand — but one last surprise leaves the entire courtroom shaken.

shows.name: Stranger Things
shows.overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Crawl
episodes.overview: November, 1987. The gang evades the military to scour the Upside Down for Vecna — but fails to notice a threat lurking closer to home.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Vanishing of...
episodes.overview: After a vicious attack at the Wheeler home, Mike and Nancy confront the cost of secrecy, while El and Hopper embark on a rescue mission.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Turnbow Trap
episodes.overview: Will gains unique insight into Vecna's next move, giving the crew an opportunity to set a trap. Holly explores her new surroundings.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Sorcerer
episodes.overview: The military tightens its grip on the town. Mike, Lucas and Robin orchestrate a daring escape. El comes face-to-face with the enemy.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: Shock Jock
episodes.overview: The gang hatches an electrifying plan to reconnect Will to the hive mind. Tensions flare during a search of the Upside Down's Hawkins Lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: Escape from Camazotz
episodes.overview: As Holly and Max fight to escape Vecna's mind, El must find a way into Will's. Joyce wrestles with guilt. Jonathan and Nancy face a turning point.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Bridge
episodes.overview: On the anniversary of Will's disappearance, the party reunites to prepare for a battle with world-altering implications.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Rightside Up
episodes.overview: As Vecna prepares to destroy the world as we know it, the party must put everything on the line to defeat him once and for all.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Hellfire Club
episodes.overview: El is bullied at school. Joyce opens a mysterious package. A scrappy player shakes up D&D night.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: Vecna's Curse
episodes.overview: A plane brings Mike to California — and a dead body brings Hawkins to a halt. Nancy goes looking for leads. A shaken Eddie tells the gang what he saw.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Monster and the Superhero
episodes.overview: Murray and Joyce fly to Alaska, and El faces serious consequences. Robin and Nancy dig up dirt on Hawkins' demons. Dr. Owens delivers sobering news.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Dear Billy
episodes.overview: Max is in grave danger... and running out of time. A patient at Pennhurst asylum has visitors. Elsewhere, in Russia, Hopper is hard at work.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Nina Project
episodes.overview: Owens takes El to Nevada, where she's forced to confront her past, while the Hawkins kids comb a crumbling house for clues. Vecna claims another victim.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Dive
episodes.overview: Behind the Iron Curtain, a risky rescue mission gets underway. The California crew seeks help from a hacker. Steve takes one for the team.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Massacre at Hawkins Lab
episodes.overview: As Hopper braces to battle a monster, Dustin dissects Vecna's motives — and decodes a message from beyond. El finds strength in a distant memory.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: Papa
episodes.overview: Nancy has sobering visions, and El passes an important test. Back in Hawkins, the gang gathers supplies and prepares for battle.

episodes.name: Chapter Nine: The Piggyback
episodes.overview: With selfless hearts and a clash of metal, heroes fight from every corner of the battlefield to save Hawkins — and the world itself.

shows.name: Only Murders in the Building
shows.overview: Three strangers share an obsession with true crime and suddenly find themselves wrapped up in one.

episodes.name: Nail in the Coffin
episodes.overview: While investigating Lester’s mysterious "accidental" death, the clues lure Charles, Oliver, and Mabel out of Manhattan — and straight into some dangerous new "old" territory.

episodes.name: After You
episodes.overview: A look back at Lester's early days at the Arconia reveals how a young dreamer became a steadfast doorman — sacrificing his future to protect the residents from the building’s secrets.

episodes.name: Rigor
episodes.overview: The trio stumbles upon a crucial piece of evidence... and promptly compromises it. With time running out, they scramble to solve the mystery before the police close in on them.

episodes.name: Dirty Birds
episodes.overview: Snooping goes sideways when three billionaire suspects catch the trio and invite themselves over for an evening at Oliver's.

episodes.name: Tongue Tied
episodes.overview: Thwarted in their investigative podcast plans, Mabel and Oliver look for help from the Arconia support staff — as Charles dines with another suspect and gets caught up in "catching" more than he bargained for.

episodes.name: Flatbush
episodes.overview: The investigation takes Oliver and Loretta back to the streets of his childhood, where buried memories surface and secrets about Lester and Nicky's widows emerge. Mabel and Charles follow leads after a break-in.

episodes.name: Silver Alert
episodes.overview: The mayor warns the trio about the billionaires, sending them to investigate further at a villainous lair upstate — as Oliver boots it in an attempted escape.

episodes.name: Cuckoo Chicks
episodes.overview: Mabel gathers a ragtag group to crash an exclusive ladies night. While trying to save the Arconia from being sold, Charles and Oliver accidentally end up in couples' therapy.

episodes.name: LESTR
episodes.overview: Told through the lens of one annoying robot who may hold the keys to more secrets than anyone realized — the Arconia throws one last party as the residents discover that a killer may still be in their building.

episodes.name: The House Always...
episodes.overview: With the clock ticking, the trio doubles down to bring "new" and "old" forces together to bring down a killer — ending in one explosive showdown and the reveals they've been chasing all season.

shows.name: Nobody Wants This
shows.overview: An agnostic sex podcaster and a newly single rabbi fall in love, but can their relationship survive their wildly different lives and meddling families?

episodes.name: Dinner Party
episodes.overview: Riding high on romance, Joanne and Noah merge their friend groups at a dinner party. But an offhand comment reveals they're not quite on the same page.

episodes.name: Leave It at the Tree
episodes.overview: When Joanne nudges Noah to express his feelings, he surprises even himself. Morgan's request for constructive feedback quickly devolves into blowback.

episodes.name: The Unethical Therapist
episodes.overview: An unlikely guest stirs things up on the podcast. Morgan's polarizing plus-one raises eyebrows at a party. Bina gets pushy with Sasha and Esther.

episodes.name: Valentine's Day
episodes.overview: When Noah cooks up a swoon-worthy Valentine's plan, Joanne worries about his true intentions — and the price of setting aside her own traditions.

episodes.name: Abby Loves Smoothies
episodes.overview: Intending to support Noah at a baby-naming ceremony, Joanne can't resist teaming up with Morgan for some payback against a former rival.

episodes.name: Anything Can Happen
episodes.overview: Still reeling from Noah's request for a "night off" from her, Joanne tries to keep it together as her parents meet his for the first time.

episodes.name: When You Know, You Know
episodes.overview: A blunder on an important shopping trip sets off fireworks on the podcast. Noah's modern new workplace delivers some old-fashioned culture shock.

episodes.name: A Better Rabbi
episodes.overview: Noah guides a surprisingly experienced new student. Joanne faces mounting pressure. Morgan recruits Sasha to dig up some digital dirt.

episodes.name: Crossroads
episodes.overview: An afternoon couples' hang goes off the rails when a provocative party game reveals everyone's most uncomfortable truths.

episodes.name: When Noah Met Joanne
episodes.overview: The complexities of love get all too real at a lavish celebration, as Joanne and Noah question what's worth holding onto — and what's slipping away.

shows.name: Wednesday
shows.overview: Smart, sarcastic and a little dead inside, Wednesday Addams investigates twisted mysteries while making new friends — and foes — at Nevermore Academy.

episodes.name: Here We Woe Again
episodes.overview: After a productive summer break, Wednesday returns to Nevermore as a grudging campus celebrity — and the target of a dangerous stalker.

episodes.name: The Devil You Woe
episodes.overview: Chaos reigns on campus as Nevermore celebrates its annual Prank Day. Wednesday confronts an old enemy and gains an unwanted ally.

episodes.name: Call of the Woe
episodes.overview: Stripped of both her ability and Goody's book, Wednesday is forced to do some old-fashioned detective work on a school camping trip.

episodes.name: If These Woes Could Talk
episodes.overview: It's an Addams family investigation as Fester and Thing commit themselves to Wednesday's case. Trying to conceal one secret, Bianca stumbles on another.

episodes.name: Hyde and Woe Seek
episodes.overview: With Tyler on the loose, Wednesday readies for a risky Día de los Muertos showdown. Slurp's growing hunger poses problems for Pugsley.

episodes.name: Woe Thyself
episodes.overview: An encounter with a spirit from Nevermore's past gives Wednesday and Enid a new perspective on one another — and puts one of their classmates in danger.

episodes.name: Woe Me the Money
episodes.overview: As the school gala looms, Wednesday digs up dirt on Dort, Enid tries not to wolf out and Morticia engages in a battle of wills with Grandmama.

episodes.name: This Means Woe
episodes.overview: When buried family secrets are unearthed, Wednesday must race against time to prevent a dark prophecy from being realized.

shows.name: The Last of Us
shows.overview: Twenty years after modern civilization has been destroyed, Joel, a hardened survivor, is hired to smuggle Ellie, a 14-year-old girl, out of an oppressive quarantine zone. What starts as a small job soon becomes a brutal, heartbreaking journey, as they both must traverse the United States and depend on each other for survival.

episodes.name: Future Days
episodes.overview: Five years after the events in Salt Lake City, a now 19-year-old Ellie makes a discovery while on patrol with her best friend Dina. Back in Jackson Hole, Joel seeks help to mend his relationship with Ellie.

episodes.name: Through the Valley
episodes.overview: As a storm brews in the mountains, the people of Jackson Hole prepare for the worst amid increased sightings of Infected. Meanwhile, Abby weighs her options.

episodes.name: The Path
episodes.overview: After Dina shares crucial information, Ellie prepares to petition the town council, even while she struggles with her deep emotional scars. On the outskirts of Seattle, a religious sect attempts to flee a war – raising questions on what lies ahead.

episodes.name: Day One
episodes.overview: In 2018, Seattle FEDRA confronts an unexpected foe. Ten years later, Ellie and Dina find themselves in the middle of a bloody battle between the zealous Seraphites and a ruthless militia.

episodes.name: Feel Her Love
episodes.overview: The WLF makes a dangerous discovery... at a great cost. Later, Ellie must decide whether to continue with her plan – and risk putting Dina in danger – or give up on her quest for justice.

episodes.name: The Price
episodes.overview: Joel surprises Ellie for her birthday. Years later, Ellie prepares to confront Joel about her past.

episodes.name: Convergence
episodes.overview: As the Wolves and the Scars prepare for a battle that could potentially end their longstanding feud, Ellie's search draws her away from her friends and toward a devastating confrontation.

episodes.name: When You're Lost in the Darkness
episodes.overview: 2003. As a parasitic fungal outbreak begins to ravage the country and the world, Joel Miller attempts to escape the escalating chaos with his daughter and brother. Twenty years later, a now hardened Joel and his partner Tess fight to survive under a totalitarian regime, while the insurgent Fireflies harbor a teenage girl with a unique gift.

episodes.name: Infected
episodes.overview: In 2003, an Indonesian scientist makes a devastating discovery. In 2023, now outside of the quarantine zone, Joel and Tess clash over Ellie's fate as they navigate a long-abandoned Boston overrun with Infected.

episodes.name: Long, Long Time
episodes.overview: Doomsday prepper Bill prepares to ride out the apocalypse alone...until a mysterious stranger upends his plans. Years later, Joel and Ellie seek Bill's guidance – and find themselves at a crossroads.

episodes.name: Please Hold to My Hand
episodes.overview: After a harrowing trek across a desolate United States, Joel and Ellie find themselves navigating a dangerous Kansas City on foot. Later, rebel leader Kathleen instigates a manhunt – one that pits her violent civilian militia against the world's best hope.

episodes.name: Endure and Survive
episodes.overview: On the streets of a newly free Kansas City, Henry fights to protect his brother Sam from rebel soldiers who will stop at nothing to appease their ruthless leader. As her manhunt continues, Kathleen doubles down on her quest for revenge, while Ellie forms a meaningful friendship.

episodes.name: Kin
episodes.overview: After months of traveling, Joel and Ellie receive a grave warning about what lies ahead. Later, Ellie learns more about Joel's past – while Joel tries his best to forget.

episodes.name: Left Behind
episodes.overview: As Joel fights to survive, Ellie’s struggle to save him stirs memories of her life in a FEDRA orphanage. Weeks before meeting Joel, Ellie recalls joining her best friend Riley for a night to remember… one that will change the course of both of their lives – and the fate of the world – forever.

episodes.name: When We Are in Need
episodes.overview: After crossing paths with a vengeful group of survivors, Ellie's fighting spirit draws unwanted attention from its leader. Still battling for his life, a weakened Joel faces off with a hunting party out for blood.

episodes.name: Look for the Light
episodes.overview: After being pursued by Infected, a pregnant Anna places her trust in a lifelong friend. Years later, Ellie is forced to grapple with the emotional toll of her journey, while Joel faces a devastating decision of his own.

shows.name: The White Lotus
shows.overview: Follow the exploits of various guests and employees at an exclusive tropical resort over the span of a week as with each passing day, a darker complexity emerges in these picture-perfect travelers, the hotel’s cheerful employees and the idyllic locale itself.

episodes.name: Same Spirits, New Forms
episodes.overview: As a new round of guests arrives at the White Lotus Thailand, Belinda settles in, Chelsea deals with a moody Rick, the Ratliffs go separate ways, and Kate, Laurie, and Jaclyn kick off a girls' trip.

episodes.name: Special Treatments
episodes.overview: Timothy gets distressing updates about his business, Chelsea connects with expat Chloe, and Gaitok shares his feelings with Mook.

episodes.name: The Meaning of Dreams
episodes.overview: Jaclyn pushes the idea of a vacation fling on Laurie. Chelsea finds herself in a perilous situation. Gaitok worries about a reprimand.

episodes.name: Hide or Seek
episodes.overview: Jaclyn looks for a different scene. Piper asks for Lochlan's support before sharing a life update. Chelsea finally gets Rick to open up.

episodes.name: Full-Moon Party
episodes.overview: As things get wild during the Full Moon festivities, Rick visits an old friend, and Belinda shares her suspicions about a hotel guest.

episodes.name: Denials
episodes.overview: In the wake of the festivities, Laurie finds herself feeling deceived by Jaclyn, while Saxon tries to bury what happened the night before.

episodes.name: Killer Instincts
episodes.overview: Belinda brings Zion to Chloe’s expat party. Saxon confronts Tim about how strange he’s been acting. Gaitok and Mook have their first date.

episodes.name: Amor Fati
episodes.overview: Laurie, Jaclyn, and Kate reckon with their friendship. Timothy comes up with a shocking plan for his family. Belinda considers a deal.

episodes.name: Ciao
episodes.overview: Two couples navigate awkwardness, an Italian American family deals with a conspicuous absence, and Tanya arrives with her new assistant.

episodes.name: Italian Dream
episodes.overview: Tanya enlists Greg to help her live out her perfect Sicilian day. Harper questions Cameron and Daphne’s claims about their marriage.

episodes.name: Bull Elephants
episodes.overview: While Daphne loops Harper into an off-resort excursion, Ethan and Cameron get in some bro time. Tanya seeks advice from a tarot reader.

episodes.name: In the Sandbox
episodes.overview: Tanya and Portia spend a day with charming ex-pats Quentin and Jack. Harper is blindsided by shocking evidence from Ethan’s night out.

episodes.name: That's Amore
episodes.overview: Tanya and Portia embark on a whirlwind excursion with Quentin and Jack. Unsure what to believe, Harper gets real with Cam and Daphne.

episodes.name: Abductions
episodes.overview: Ethan grows suspicious of Cam. Tanya gives Portia an opaque warning about Jack. Lucia helps the Di Grassos search for long-lost relatives.

episodes.name: Arrivederci
episodes.overview: Albie asks Dominic for a karmic payment to help Lucia. Tanya grows wary of Quentin’s motives. Ethan confronts Cam.

shows.name: Severance
shows.overview: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.

episodes.name: Hello, Ms. Cobel
episodes.overview: Mark returns to work under different circumstances. Secrets from the Outie world come to light.

episodes.name: Goodbye, Mrs. Selvig
episodes.overview: Mark contemplates the meaning of a message.

episodes.name: Who Is Alive?
episodes.overview: Mark, Helly, Irving, and Dylan search for answers.

episodes.name: Woe's Hollow
episodes.overview: The team participates in a group activity.

episodes.name: Trojan's Horse
episodes.overview: Tensions emerge after the team suffers a loss.

episodes.name: Attila
episodes.overview: Bonds are tested. Mark continues on his path of discovery.

episodes.name: Chikhai Bardo
episodes.overview: An old romance intersects with a deadly present threat.

episodes.name: Sweet Vitriol
episodes.overview: Discoveries are made.

episodes.name: The After Hours
episodes.overview: Mark and Devon team with an ally. Helly investigates further.

episodes.name: Cold Harbor
episodes.overview: Mark forms a shaky alliance in an all-or-nothing play, while the team makes a dangerous last stand.

shows.name: Young Sheldon
shows.overview: The early life of child genius Sheldon Cooper, later seen in The Big Bang Theory.

episodes.name: A Wiener Schnitzel and Underwear in a Tree
episodes.overview: News of the tornado reaches Sheldon and Mary in Germany. Also, with the Cooper house in chaos, Missy steps up.

episodes.name: A Roulette Wheel and a Piano Playing Dog
episodes.overview: Sheldon realizes he is the weakest student in his class; Meemaw is looking to expand her gambling business.

episodes.name: A Strudel and a Hot American Boy Toy
episodes.overview: Sheldon explores Germany behind Mary's back, Missy attempts to pull a fast one on George Sr. and Meemaw and Dale adjust to living together.

episodes.name: Ants on a Log and a Cheating Winker
episodes.overview: Missy steps up, Mary has a surprise for George, and Sheldon finds his dorm occupied.

episodes.name: A Frankenstein's Monster and a Crazy Church Guy
episodes.overview: Sheldon helps his roommate try to beat the stock market, Missy and Billy Sparks throw a party, and Mary finds a new church.

episodes.name: Baptists, Catholics and an Attempted Drowning
episodes.overview: Georgie and Mandy's wedding plans pit Mary against Mandy's mom, Audrey, with baby CeeCee caught in the middle.

episodes.name: A Proper Wedding and Skeletons in the Closet
episodes.overview: Georgie and Mandy get married! Meanwhile, Meemaw's gambling room gets raided.

episodes.name: An Ankle Monitor and a Big Plastic Crap House
episodes.overview: Sheldon studies to be Meemaw's lawyer when she is put on house arrest, and the Coopers have a plumbing emergency.

episodes.name: A Fancy Article and a Scholarship for a Baby
episodes.overview: Sheldon's published paper leads to a frenzy of grad school recruiting, and Georgie tries to speak more properly in front of his daughter.

episodes.name: Community Service and the Key to a Happy Marriage
episodes.overview: Connie gets assigned a tough probation officer, and Georgie takes marriage advice from his father-in-law.

episodes.name: A Little Snip and Teaching Old Dogs
episodes.overview: George Sr. is worried that Mary wants another baby and gets a vasectomy behind her back. Meanwhile, Drs. Linkletter and Sturgis go to Sheldon for science tutoring.

episodes.name: A New Home and a Traditional Texas Torture
episodes.overview: George Sr. gets an exciting job offer, and Sheldon prepares for his move to California.

episodes.name: Funeral (1)
episodes.overview: The Cooper family grapples with the death of George Cooper Sr.

episodes.name: Memoir (2)
episodes.overview: Sheldon leaves East Texas for the California Institute of Technology following the death of his father.

episodes.name: Four Hundred Cartons of Undeclared Cigarettes and a Niblingo
episodes.overview: George Sr. bails Connie and Georgie out of jail. Also, Sheldon and Missy meet Mandy, and Mary feels unwelcome at church.

episodes.name: Future Worf and the Margarita of the South Pacific
episodes.overview: Sheldon and Missy try to help the family’s finances. Also, Mary struggles to find her footing without the church.

episodes.name: Passion's Harvest and a Sheldocracy
episodes.overview: Sheldon must choose sides in an ethical dilemma. Also, Mary tries her hand at writing and Mandy needs a new place to live.

episodes.name: Blonde Ambition and the Concept of Zero
episodes.overview: Sheldon makes a terrifying mathematical discovery while tutoring Billy. Also, Mary is jealous of Missy's relationship with Mandy and Connie.

episodes.name: A Resident Advisor and the Word 'Sketchy'
episodes.overview: At college, Sheldon decides to expand his responsibilities and become a dorm resident advisor. Also, Connie and Dale make a sketchy business deal, and Mary and George Sr. rekindle their romance.

episodes.name: An Ugly Car, an Affair and Some Kickass Football
episodes.overview: George Sr. is asked to help with the football team. Also, Mandy discovers Georgie and Connie's secret business.

episodes.name: A Tougher Nut and a Note on File
episodes.overview: Sheldon's search for a comic book leads him to a breakthrough. Also, Georgie and Mandy have an uncomfortable first encounter with her parents, Jim and Audrey.

episodes.name: Legalese and a Whole Hoo-Ha
episodes.overview: Sheldon's database invention puts him at odds with the university. Also, the church takes issue with Connie's video store.

episodes.name: College Dropouts and the Medford Miracle
episodes.overview: Sheldon considers dropping out of college to focus on building his database. Also, George Sr. is frustrated when someone else gets credit for his football wins.

episodes.name: Pancake Sunday and Textbook Flirting
episodes.overview: Mary struggles to make new friends while Mandy pushes Georgie to date another woman.

episodes.name: Ruthless, Toothless and a Week of Bed Rest
episodes.overview: Sheldon learns the university is building a database without him. Also, Mary takes care of a bedridden Mandy and Meemaw.

episodes.name: A Baby Shower and a Testosterone-Rich Banter
episodes.overview: Mary butts heads with Mandy's mother, Audrey, and Sheldon attempts male bonding.

episodes.name: A Frat Party, a Sleepover and the Mother of All Blisters
episodes.overview: Paige drags Sheldon to a college party and Missy gets caught in a lie.

episodes.name: A Launch Party and a Whole Human Being
episodes.overview: The Coopers can't be found as Mandy goes into labor. Also, Sheldon is excited about the launch of his database.

episodes.name: Teen Angst and a Smart-Boy Walk of Shame
episodes.overview: Sheldon confronts the failure of his database. Also, Georgie and Mandy struggle as new parents and Missy feels forgotten.

episodes.name: A Stolen Truck and Going on the Lam
episodes.overview: Missy steals her dad's truck and hits the road with her friend Paige.

episodes.name: A German Folk Song and an Actual Adult
episodes.overview: Georgie goes on a birthday date and Mary confronts Brenda about her relationship with George. Also, Sheldon takes an interest in Missy's favorite TV show.

episodes.name: Little Green Men and a Fella's Marriage Proposal
episodes.overview: Sheldon wants to search for life on other planets and Mandy answers Georgie's marriage proposal. Also, Missy is caught between two friends.

episodes.name: A New Weather Girl and a Stay-at-Home Coddler
episodes.overview: Mandy gets an exciting job opportunity and Sheldon worries that he's falling behind. Also, Georgie takes his daughter to work.

episodes.name: German for Beginners and a Crazy Old Man with a Bat
episodes.overview: The gambling room gets broken into and Sheldon wants to study abroad. Also, Missy makes a new friend.

episodes.name: A Romantic Getaway and a Germanic Meat-Based Diet
episodes.overview: Mandy surprises Georgie with a spa weekend and Sheldon prepares for his summer in Germany.

episodes.name: A Tornado, a 10-Hour Flight and a Darn Fine Ring
episodes.overview: Sheldon and Mary head to Germany while the rest of the Cooper family braves a tornado that is heading straight for Medford.

shows.name: The Mandalorian
shows.overview: After the fall of the Galactic Empire, lawlessness has spread throughout the galaxy. A lone gunfighter makes his way through the outer reaches, earning his keep as a bounty hunter.

episodes.name: Chapter 17: The Apostate
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian begins an important journey.

episodes.name: Chapter 18: The Mines of Mandalore
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian and Grogu explore the ruins of a destroyed planet.

episodes.name: Chapter 19: The Convert
episodes.overview: On Coruscant, former Imperials find amnesty in the New Republic.

episodes.name: Chapter 20: The Foundling
episodes.overview: Din Djarin returns to the hidden Mandalorian covert.

episodes.name: Chapter 21: The Pirate
episodes.overview: The people of Nevarro need protection from rampant pirate attacks.

episodes.name: Chapter 22: Guns for Hire
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian visits an opulent world.

episodes.name: Chapter 23: The Spies
episodes.overview: Survivors come out of hiding.

episodes.name: Chapter 24: The Return
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian and his allies confront their enemies.

episodes.name: Chapter 9: The Marshal
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian is drawn to the Outer Rim in search of others of his kind.

episodes.name: Chapter 10: The Passenger
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian must ferry a passenger with precious cargo on a risky journey.

episodes.name: Chapter 11: The Heiress
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian braves high seas and meets unexpected allies.

episodes.name: Chapter 12: The Siege
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian rejoins old allies for a new mission.

episodes.name: Chapter 13: The Jedi
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian journeys to a world ruled by a cruel magistrate who has made a powerful enemy.

episodes.name: Chapter 14: The Tragedy
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian and Child travel to an ancient site.

episodes.name: Chapter 15: The Believer
episodes.overview: To move against the Empire, the Mandalorian needs the help of an old enemy.

episodes.name: Chapter 16: The Rescue
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian and his allies attempt a daring rescue.

shows.name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
shows.overview: In a dystopia riddled with corruption and cybernetic implants, a talented but reckless street kid strives to become a mercenary outlaw — an edgerunner.

episodes.name: Let You Down
episodes.overview: After a night of streaming illegal braindance, David wakes up to reality: a rundown apartment with a broken washing machine and an overworked mother.

episodes.name: Like a Boy
episodes.overview: With his newly enhanced body, David heads to the Academy seeking revenge on his bully. Later, he meets a mysterious woman who wants to recruit him.

episodes.name: Smooth Criminal
episodes.overview: Surrounded by a group of rowdy edgerunners, David makes a plea to join their team. Meanwhile, sinister forces plot to lure him back to Arasaka Academy.

episodes.name: Lucky You
episodes.overview: Eager to learn the edgerunner ropes, David pesters Maine for another mission. Instead, Maine tasks Lucy with training him.

episodes.name: All Eyez on Me
episodes.overview: David makes a clever suggestion when the team strategizes for their next mission. However, he soon learns that their target can't be underestimated.

episodes.name: Girl on Fire
episodes.overview: Maine doesn't seem to be himself. But the team has bigger fish to fry: They must race against time to extract vital information from their prisoner.

episodes.name: Stronger
episodes.overview: Now an all-star edgerunner enhanced with more cybernetics, David leads his team into a new mission. An old contact reaches out to him for a big job.

episodes.name: Stay
episodes.overview: Faraday finds himself stuck between Arasaka and Militech. Lucy and Rebecca confront David about his change in behavior, but he refuses to listen.

episodes.name: Humanity
episodes.overview: Lucy's captors learn about her secret mission and dark past. David and his team head out to complete Faraday's job but realize that something is off.

episodes.name: My Moon My Man
episodes.overview: On the edge of cyberpsychosis but determined to save Lucy, David storms into Night City as Arasaka plots to deploy their ultimate lethal weapon.

shows.name: The Big Bang Theory
shows.overview: Physicists Leonard and Sheldon find their nerd-centric social circle with pals Howard and Raj expanding when aspiring actress Penny moves in next door.

episodes.name: The Conjugal Configuration
episodes.overview: Sheldon and Amy's honeymoon runs aground in New York. Penny and Leonard discover they are uncomfortably similar to Amy's parents. Raj insults physicist Neil deGrasse Tyson and starts a Twitter war.

episodes.name: The Wedding Gift Wormhole
episodes.overview: Sheldon and Amy drive themselves crazy trying to figure out what 'perfect gift' Leonard and Penny gave them for their wedding. Raj decides he wants to settle down and asks his father to arrange a marriage for him.

episodes.name: The Procreation Calculation
episodes.overview: The Wolowitzes' life gets complicated when Stuart starts bringing his new girlfriend home. Also, Penny and Leonard talk about starting a family, while Raj explores an arranged marriage.

episodes.name: The Tam Turbulence
episodes.overview: When Sheldon won't tell anyone why he's never mentioned his childhood best friend, Leonard takes matters into his own hands. Bernadette and Penny take out Raj’s fiancée for dinner to get the skinny on her.

episodes.name: The Planetarium Collision
episodes.overview: When Amy doesn’t have time to work on super-asymmetry, Sheldon goes to great lengths to ensure she’s available to work with him even it if means accidentally sabotaging her career in the process. Raj doesn’t want Howard to join him in hosting a show at the planetarium.

episodes.name: The Imitation Perturbation
episodes.overview: When Howard dresses up as Sheldon for Halloween, Sheldon seeks retaliation at Leonard and Penny's Halloween party. Leonard is shocked that Penny doesn't remember their first kiss.

episodes.name: The Grant Allocation Derivation
episodes.overview: Leonard is caught between a rock and a hard place when he's responsible for distributing extra grant money. Bernadette turns the backyard playhouse into a hideaway from Howard and the kids.

episodes.name: The Consummation Deviation
episodes.overview: Sheldon tries to bond with Amy's father, but when Howard lures Mr. Fowler away with magic tricks, Sheldon has no choice but to bond with Mrs. Fowler. Raj and Anu try to get physical for the first time.

episodes.name: The Citation Negation
episodes.overview: Sheldon and Amy are devastated after learning from a Russian paper that Super Asymmetry has already been theorized and disproven. Meanwhile, ultra-competitive Bernadette asks Stuart’s girlfriend to teach her how to beat Howard in a popular video game.

episodes.name: The VCR Illumination
episodes.overview: Sheldon and Amy are still down about their theory being disproven, but a VHS tape from Sheldon’s past inspires him not to give up. Bernadette turns into a pageant mom when she tries to help Howard ace his Magic Castle audition.

episodes.name: The Paintball Scattering
episodes.overview: Penny and Leonard organize a paintball game that results in mayhem when Sheldon is jealous of Amy. Also, Raj catches Anu with her ex-boyfriend, and Stuart gets cold feet when Denise hints at the possibility of them living together.

episodes.name: The Propagation Proposition
episodes.overview: Penny runs into her ex-boyfriend, Zack, who invites her and Leonard to a dinner to meet his newlywed wife. After the dinner the newlywed couple make an odd proposition to Leonard, which makes Penny to freak out. Also, Raj attempts to mend things with his ex-fiancée, Anu.

episodes.name: The Confirmation Polarization
episodes.overview: Sheldon and Amy are thrilled when their super asymmetry theory is proven by two physicists, until they try to kick Amy off the Nobel nomination. Also, Bernadette gets one of her drugs approved at work and wants a reluctant Penny to head the sales team.

episodes.name: The Meteorite Manifestation
episodes.overview: Sheldon is thrilled to help Bernadette and Wolowitz navigate bureaucratic paperwork, until he discovers they are breaking the law. Also, Leonard is disappointed when his friends exclude him from a scientific project.

episodes.name: The Donation Oscillation
episodes.overview: Penny tries to seduce an abstaining Leonard to ruin his "donation" for her ex-boyfriend, Zack, and his wife, Marissa. Also, Wolowitz, Bernadette, Anu and Koothrappali turn Koothrappali's canceled bachelor party into a couple's trip.

episodes.name: The D & D Vortex
episodes.overview: The gang finds out Wil Wheaton hosts a celebrity Dungeons and Dragons game involving William Shatner, Joe Manganiello, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar and Kevin Smith. Deception and betrayal are the path to make it to the one open seat.

episodes.name: The Conference Valuation
episodes.overview: When Penny and Bernadette go to San Diego for a pharmaceutical sales convention, Wolowitz is in charge of the kids. Also, Sheldon finds a book on experimenting on kids, and the guys plus Amy make a day of it.

episodes.name: The Laureate Accumulation
episodes.overview: When competitors Pemberton and Campbell charm America on a publicity tour, Sheldon and Amy try to bring Nobel laureates Kip Thorne, George Smoot and Frances Arnold to their side. Also, Halley's fear of the dark causes opportunity and conflict at the Wolowitz home.

episodes.name: The Inspiration Deprivation
episodes.overview: The concept of what it would mean for women everywhere if Amy were to win a Nobel Prize causes Amy to have a meltdown. Also, Howard and Raj try to relive the good old days after Howard buys a scooter that looks like the one he had years ago.

episodes.name: The Decision Reverberation
episodes.overview: Raj is worried people won’t take him seriously in his own field after publishing a paper that suggests he may have discovered alien life. Also, Leonard wants to be the principal investigator on a plasma physics study.

episodes.name: The Plagiarism Schism
episodes.overview: Kripke has proof that Dr. Pemberton plagiarized his thesis in college, and Sheldon and Amy aren't sure if they should turn him in or not. Meanwhile, Howard learns that Bernadette wasn't the only waitress at the Cheesecake Factory who had a crush on him.

episodes.name: The Maternal Conclusion
episodes.overview: Leonard is pleasantly surprised when Beverly comes to visit and she's genuinely kind to him, until he finds out the real reason she's there. Also, Denise and Stuart overstay their welcome at the Wolowitz house.

episodes.name: The Change Constant / The Stockholm Syndrome
episodes.overview: Sheldon and Amy await big news. Meanwhile, Penny and Leonard have some big news of their own. Also, Howard and Bernadette face the stressful challenge of leaving their kids for the first time and Raj makes a new friend, as the gang travels together into an uncharted future.

episodes.name: Unraveling the Mystery: A Big Bang Farewell
episodes.overview: Johnny Galecki and Kaley Cuoco will lead fans on a trip down memory lane, sharing some of the best-kept backstage secrets and personal memories from the past 12 years.

episodes.name: The Proposal Proposal
episodes.overview: In the eleventh season opener, Amy gives Sheldon an answer to his proposal while Howard and Bernadette struggle with some unexpected news.

episodes.name: The Retraction Reaction
episodes.overview: Leonard angers the university – and the entire physics community – after he gives an embarrassing interview. Also, Amy and Bernadette bond over having to hide their success from Sheldon and Howard.

episodes.name: The Relaxation Integration
episodes.overview: Sheldon and Amy struggle with picking a wedding date, which stresses out Sheldon and causes him talking in his sleep. Meanwhile, Raj and Stuart fight over the attention of one of Bernadette's co-workers.

episodes.name: The Explosion Implosion
episodes.overview: As Howard worries about fatherhood, he and Sheldon bond when they jointly assemble a model rocket. Meanwhile, Penny bonds with Leonard's mother, Beverly, much to his concern.

episodes.name: The Collaboration Contamination
episodes.overview: Sheldon and Raj confide in Bernadette when they can't handle Amy and Howard working together on a science project. Also, Penny and Leonard learn new tactics for how to deal with Sheldon from an unlikely source.

episodes.name: The Proton Regeneration
episodes.overview: Sheldon goes head-to-head with Wil Wheaton for the role of the new Professor Proton. Also, Penny steps in to take care of Halley when Bernadette and Howard both wind up on bed rest.

episodes.name: The Geology Methodology
episodes.overview: Sheldon and Bert collaborate on a research project, despite Sheldon’s embarrassment. Also, Penny and Bernadette coach Raj on how to navigate his relationship with Ruchi.

episodes.name: The Tesla Recoil
episodes.overview: Leonard and Howard are furious after they learn Sheldon went to work with the military behind their backs. Also, while Bernadette is on bed rest, she asks Raj to do some digging when she suspects that Ruchi might be trying to take over her projects at work.

episodes.name: The Bitcoin Entanglement
episodes.overview: Sheldon tries to teach the guys a lesson after they cut him out of a potentially valuable Bitcoin investment. Also, a seven-year-old video reveals a secret about Leonard and Penny's relationship.

episodes.name: The Confidence Erosion
episodes.overview: Sheldon and Amy try to eliminate stress from wedding planning by applying math to the process. Also, Raj “breaks up” with Howard after realizing his best friend is actually hurting his confidence.

episodes.name: The Celebration Reverberation
episodes.overview: Raj and Howard's feud continues as the gang plan Halley's first birthday party. Sheldon's surprise for Amy's birthday goes awry when they get food poisoning. Also, Leonard gets a Christmas letter from his brother that causes him to spiral out about his own lack of accomplishments.

episodes.name: The Matrimonial Metric
episodes.overview: Sheldon and Amy try to pick their Best-Man and Maid of Honor by experimenting on the gang.

episodes.name: The Solo Oscillation
episodes.overview: When Sheldon kicks Amy out to work solo, she and Leonard bond during a series of science experiments. Also, Bert the geologist replaces Wolowitz in the band Footprints on the Moon, and Sheldon finds Penny a surprising source of scientific inspiration.

episodes.name: The Separation Triangulation
episodes.overview: Raj finds himself in the middle of domestic drama when he learns the woman he's dating, has a very upset husband. Also, when Sheldon rents his old room back for a quiet place to work, he drives Leonard crazy by being a model tenant.

episodes.name: The Novelization Correlation
episodes.overview: Leonard's book raises questions, and Amy guest stars on the new Professor Proton show.

episodes.name: The Neonatal Nomenclature
episodes.overview: When Bernadette won't go into labor, the gang tries different tactics to get things started. Also, Howard confronts Bernadette after Amy accidentally reveals she's already chosen their son's name.

episodes.name: The Athenaeum Allocation
episodes.overview: Leonard jumps through hoops to help secure the perfect wedding venue for Sheldon and Amy. Also, Bernadette and Howard have a hard time deciding who should stay at home with the kids and who should go back to work.

episodes.name: The Gates Excitation
episodes.overview: Bill Gates visits Penny's work, and the gang schemes to meet him. Hilarity ensues. Meanwhile, Sheldon is convinced that he's a target of an April's Fools prank.

episodes.name: The Tenant Disassociation
episodes.overview: When Leonard learns Sheldon is the president of the tenants association, he decides to run against him. Also, Bernadette encourages Howard and Raj to find the owner of a drone after they find it in the backyard.

episodes.name: The Reclusive Potential
episodes.overview: A brilliant but reclusive scientist, Doctor Wolcott, invites Sheldon to his cabin in the middle of nowhere, and Leonard, Raj and Howard go along for the trip. Also, Penny and Bernadette improvise after Amy doesn’t like the tame bachelorette party they planned for her.

episodes.name: The Comet Polarization
episodes.overview: Sheldon’s comic book store experience changes when writer Neil Gaiman puts Stuart’s store on the map. Also, friendships are threatened when Raj takes credit for Penny's astronomical discovery.

episodes.name: The Monetary Insufficiency
episodes.overview: Sheldon goes to Vegas to win money for science. Also, Penny and Bernadette take Amy wedding dress shopping, but her terrible choice entangles them in a web of lies.

episodes.name: The Sibling Realignment
episodes.overview: When Sheldon learns that his mother won’t attend his wedding unless he invites his brother, Georgie, he and Leonard travel to Texas to end a family feud. Also, the Wolowitz kids inadvertently infest Amy, Bernadette, Howard and Raj with pinkeye.

episodes.name: The Bow Tie Asymmetry
episodes.overview: When Amy's parents and Sheldon's family arrive, everybody is focused to make sure all wedding arrangements go according to plan – everyone except the bride and groom.
